TL;DR: 本文研究了合成数据增强中合成样本与真实训练数据之间的几何关系对分类性能的影响。在话语语用功能分类任务中，使用410条人工标注的look实例，通过Llama 3.1生成合成样本并按其在RoBERTa嵌入空间中与真实训练数据的余弦距离进行划分。研究发现，靠近真实决策边界的邻近样本（NEAR）在macro F上提升最大（0.113），距离平衡混合在准确率上最高（0.748），但没有条件能改善AUC，说明数据增强主要移动决策边界而非改善底层概率估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NLP中的合成数据增强主要关注生成样本的数量和多样性，而忽视了合成样本与真实训练数据之间的几何关系及其对模型性能的影响。作者希望探究在话语语用功能分类这一数据稀疏是结构性特征而非偶然现象的任务中，合成样本在表示空间中的位置是否比其数量更重要。

Method: 使用来自英国国家语料库的410条人工标注的英语单词look实例（涵盖注意力信号、指示语、话语标记词和感叹词四种功能），利用Llama 3.1生成合成训练样本，并在RoBERTa嵌入空间中按合成样本与真实训练数据的余弦距离进行划分。设计六种训练条件，在这些条件中控制增强数量恒定，仅改变合成样本相对于经验决策边界的位置，比较各条件在macro F、准确率和AUC上的表现。

Result: 所有增强条件相比仅使用真实数据的基线在macro F和准确率上均有提升。邻近真实数据的合成样本（NEAR）在macro F上取得最大增益（0.113），距离平衡混合设置在准确率上最高（0.748）。然而没有任何条件能改善AUC，表明数据增强的作用在于移动决策边界而非提升模型底层概率估计的质量。

Conclusion: 合成样本在表示空间中的落点位置与生成数量同等重要，甚至在距离平衡和邻近条件下更具优势。这一发现对低资源话语语用分类任务及其他数据稀缺场景的合成数据增强策略设计具有广泛启示意义，提示研究者不应仅关注增强样本的多寡，还需考虑其与真实数据分布的空间关系。

Abstract: Synthetic data augmentation has become a common strategy for addressing class imbalance in NLP, but most approaches focus on the quantity and diversity of generated examples rather than their geometric relationship to real training data. We investigate this question in the context of discourse pragmatic function classification, a task where data sparsity is a structural feature rather than a collection artefact. Using 410 manually annotated instances of the English word look drawn from the British National Corpus, spanning four functions: Attention Signal, Directive, Discourse Marker, and Interjection. We generate synthetic training examples with Llama 3.1 and partition them by their cosine distance from real training data in RoBERTa embedding space. We compare six training conditions that differ in the placement of synthetic examples relative to the empirical decision boundary, while holding augmentation quantity constant across conditions. All augmented conditions improve macro F and accuracy over the real only baseline, but core proximal examples (NEAR) yield the largest gains in macro F (0.113), while a distance balanced mix achieves the highest accuracy (0.748). No condition improves AUC, indicating that augmentation shifts the decision boundary rather than improving the model's underlying probability estimates. These findings suggest that where synthetic examples land in representation space matters as much as how many are generated, with implications for low resource pragmatic classification more broadly.

</details>


### [155] [Enhancing Financial Question Answering: A Novel Benchmark Dataset of Banks' financial statements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03654)
*Arianna Miola,Bruno Spaccavento,Lorenzo Silotto,Marco Bianchetti,Luca Cagliero*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FinRAG-QA是一个新的金融问答基准数据集，包含999个由从业者手工构建的问题，基于2019-2023年间24家欧洲和美国主要银行的209份年报及Pillar 3报告。论文评估了多阶段RAG流水线中各组件贡献：上下文分块增强结合检索优化的嵌入模型将NDCG@10从0.322提升至0.710；在检索到正确答案的前提下，推理优化的生成器将准确率从44.6%提升至79.0%（+34.4个百分点），但延迟约为20倍。研究还发现交叉编码重排在首轮检索已很强时会降低效果，且生成阶段单个顶级分块优于更大上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融QA基准集中于美国申报文件及单一机构分析，缺乏跨机构检索能力；银行财务报表的复杂性、冗长性和异质性使得自动化问答面临巨大挑战，需要一个能够评估跨机构信息检索与推理的基准数据集。

Method: 构建包含999个从业者挑选问题、10个标准化指标、209份跨机构报告（平均19.8万字）的FinRAG-QA基准；在此之上评估多阶段RAG流水线，分别隔离并分析上下文分块增强、检索优化嵌入模型、推理优化生成器、交叉编码重排序及上下文大小对最终效果的影响。

Result: 上下文分块增强结合检索优化嵌入模型将NDCG@10从0.322提升至0.710；条件于正确信息被检索到的场景下，推理优化生成器将答案准确率从44.6%提升至79.0%（提升34.4个百分点），但延迟约为20倍。交叉编码重排在首轮检索较强时会损害检索效果；单个顶级分块在生成阶段优于更大上下文。

Conclusion: 跨机构金融QA有效性的关键在于检索阶段的分块增强与嵌入模型优化、以及生成阶段采用推理优化模型，同时中等规模上下文在生成时已足够。研究为未来金融领域RAG系统各组件的消融分析提供了标准化基准。

Abstract: The comparative analysis of banks' financial statements poses significant challenges for automated question answering systems due to their complexity, substantial length, technical language, and inhomogeneity of both textual and numerical content across different jurisdictions and institutions. We introduce FinRAG-QA, a novel benchmark dataset for financial question answering, which comprises 999 practitioner-curated questions on 10 standardised indicators, grounded in 209 annual and Pillar 3 reports from 24 major European and U.S. banks spanning 2019-2023. Unlike prior financial QA benchmarks, which centre on U.S. filings and single-institution analysis, FinRAG-QA targets cross-institutional retrieval over documents averaging 198k words, longer than any existing financial QA resource. On this benchmark we evaluate a multi-stage RAG pipeline and isolate the contribution of each component. Contextual chunk enrichment combined with a retrieval-optimised embedding model raises NDCG@10 from 0.322 to 0.710; conditional on the ground truth being retrieved, a reasoning-optimised generator raises answer accuracy from 44.6% to 79.0% (+34.4 percentage points), at roughly 20x the generation latency. We further show that cross-encoder reranking degrades retrieval when the first-stage ranking is already strong, and that a single top-ranked chunk outperforms larger contexts at generation time. Experiments were run in late 2024-early 2025 with the models available at that time.

</details>


### [156] [A Circuit for Plural Reference: How LLMs Represent and Retrieve Singular and Plural Entities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03687)
*Anh Danh,Rick Nouwen,Massimo Poesio*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过机制可解释性和注意力模式分析，研究了大型语言模型（LLM）如何表示和检索单数/复数实体以进行复数指代消解，识别出负责表示、识别和传递核心指代信息的注意力头，并发现LLM在复数代词偏好上与人类一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指代消解是上下文推理中的重要任务，但LLM如何在内部分别表示和检索单复数实体以支持复数指代（plural reference）的底层机制尚不清楚。理解这一过程有助于揭示LLM在复数指代推理中的工作机制。

Method: 结合机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）与注意力模式分析，运用一系列因果干预（causal intervention）技术，研究LLM预测回指代词（coreferent pronoun）的过程。通过干预识别出负责三类功能的注意力头：(1) 表示输入中的核心指代信息；(2) 识别构成复数指代的实体；(3) 将信息传递给负责候选先行词选择和代词预测的组件。

Result: 识别出一组负责复数核心指代表示与检索的注意力头，并发现LLM在复数代词偏好上表现出与人类一致的规律：由连词"and"连接且本体论上相似的实体更倾向于被整体指代为复数实体。

Conclusion: LLM处理复数指代遵循可解释的神经机制路径（表示→识别→传递→选择），且在复数代词偏好上与人类认知一致，表明类比人类的语义约束（本体相似性与连接词）在模型内部得到了体现。

Abstract: Coreference resolution is an important task in contextual reasoning. In this paper, we investigate the mechanism for representing and retrieving singular and plural entities for plural reference. We use a combination of mechanistic interpretability and attention pattern analysis to study the process in which LLMs predict a pronoun to refer back to previously mentioned entities. Using a range of causal intervention techniques, we find a set of attention heads that are responsible for (1) representing coreference information in the input, (2) identifying entities that form a plural reference, (3) transferring the information to the component that is responsible for selecting the antecedents and predicting the pronoun. We also find that LLMs align with humans in preference for plural pronoun. Specifically, entities in a plural construction are more likely to be referred to as a plural entity if they are ontologically similar and are linked by the conjunction "and".

</details>


### [157] [Opening mind by opening architecture: analysis strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03719)
*Francesco Vitucci,Giuseppe Silvi,Daniele Giuseppe Annese,Francesco Scagliola,Anthony Di Furia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探讨了电动声学作曲中数字信号处理环境的发展困境，批评了封闭架构音频处理器（"黑箱"模式）所导致的研发环境损失，并提出通过文学/文献视角重访历史信号处理技术（以Manfred Schroeder的混响器为案例），以建立分析评估工具和意识化的研究方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着数字市场工具的主导，特定的研发环境逐渐消失，封闭架构音频处理器虽强大但无法揭示内部处理过程与交互系统，形成不可透视的"黑箱"。作者认为这种可感知输出但不可理解内部机制的模式是一种损失，需要被认真对待。

Method: 通过文献（文学）的棱镜重新审视数字信号处理环境，主张恢复科学方法和研究态度。具体以Manfred Schroeder的历史混响器为案例，展示构建分析性评估工具和实际实现工具的完整过程，以支撑一条有意识的学习研究路径。

Result: 通过案例研究展示了如何将历史信号处理技术从"黑箱"中解放出来，建立分析性评估工具与实际实现工具，使研究者能够以新的认知重新进入这些技术环境。

Conclusion: 任何数字信号处理技术都承载着历史与审美的多义层积，犹如语言中的词汇。通过文献视角和科学方法重建对历史技术环境的认知，可以对抗封闭架构带来的知识流失，支撑有意识的研究路径。

Abstract: In numerical signal processing for electroacoustic composition, the progressive loss of specific development and research environments caused by the increasing use of digital market tools has favoured the dominance of the closed-architecture audio processor model. This model, while powerful, envisions the possibility of describing output data about its perceived characteristics, but at the cost of ignoring its internal process and interacting systems, which become complex, powerful environments but closed in an inscrutable black box, a loss we must consider. Any digital signal processing technique tells a story. Just as the words of a language incorporate social, historical and technical polysemic layers, a signal processor has its own story of implementation, a gradual technological achievement with its inevitable aesthetic consequences. Through the looking-glass of literature, one can access those environments with renewed awareness by reestablishing a scientific method and an attitude to research. In this specific case, starting from the case study of Manfred Schroeder's historical reverbs, we illustrate the process of building analytical evaluation tools, as well as practical implementation, at the basis of a conscious study path.

</details>


### [158] [Beyond BLEU: A Case for Redefining Sign Language Translation Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03734)
*Oline Ranum,Edward Fish,Simon Hadfield,Richard Bowden*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出BLEU-4作为手语翻译（SLT）标准评测指标存在缺陷，因其基于口语语言先验且易受伪相关影响。作者提出了基于开放权重大语言模型（LLM）的问答（QA）评测协议，用于衡量显著内容保持能力，该指标更贴近人类排名且对释义更具不变性。应用该指标后发现，无手语注释（gloss-free）系统在Phoenix-2014T上性能几乎无差异，而带手语注释（gloss-supervised）系统高出9.3分，这一差距是BLEU-4无法揭示的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLT评测依赖BLEU-4，但口语语言评测指标难以准确反映手语能力，且多模态低资源场景使模型可通过利用虚假相关性和口语先验来获得高BLEU分数，而非真正学习更强的手语表征。因此需要一种更贴合手语内容理解的评测方法。

Method: 在Phoenix-2014T和CSL-Daily两个数据集上，对6个SLT模型考察时空理解与BLEU-4的关系。提出受语言学习评估启发的评测协议：利用开放权重LLM构建QA协议，衡量显著内容保持程度，并检验其与人类排名的对齐度和释义不变性。

Result: BLEU-4分数的提升并不代表手语理解能力的提升；新QA协议与人类排名更一致，释义不变性比BLEU-4高出6至7倍。应用新协议后，5个无gloss系统在Phoenix-2014T上性能差异在噪声范围内，而有gloss监督的系统高出9.3分，该差异BLEU-4无法呈现。

Conclusion: BLEU-4不能充分反映手语翻译模型的内容理解和翻译质量，新的LLM-QA评测协议能更可靠地衡量内容传递，对训练-测试重叠更具鲁棒性，并揭示了gloss监督对SLT性能的真实贡献，为SLT领域提供了更公允的评测视角。

Abstract: BLEU-4 is the standard metric for evaluating sign language translation (SLT), but spoken-language metrics may not adequately reflect sign language proficiency. The multimodal, low-resource context of SLT allows models to exploit spurious correlations and spoken-language priors, rather than learning stronger sign representations. In this paper, we evaluate the relationship between spatio-temporal understanding and BLEU-4 across six SLT models on Phoenix-2014T and CSL-Daily, showing that gains in BLEU-4 are not on their own evidence of better sign language understanding. This work introduces an alternative inspired by language-learning assessment, using an open-weight-LLM QA protocol that measures salient content preservation. It aligns more closely with human rankings and is six to seven times more paraphrase-invariant than BLEU-4. Applied to SLT, this protocol targets content transfer, is more robust to train-test overlap, and gives a different picture of the field: the five gloss-free systems are largely within noise of one another on Phoenix-2014T, while the gloss-supervised system stands 9.3 points higher, a gap invisible to BLEU-4.

</details>


### [159] [Typological Feature Prediction with Large Language Models: An In-Context Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03775)
*Qianwen Wang,York Hay Ng,Aditya Khan,En-Shiun Annie Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了利用大语言模型（LLM）通过上下文学习进行类型学特征预测，结合URIEL+和Glottolog的语言数据，发现零样本提示不足，但引入系统发育和地理邻域证据后，LLM显著优于所有基线且不牺牲低资源语言的预测性能，同时大多数推理与证据一致，向可解释的类型学特征预测迈进一步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类型学特征广泛用于多语言NLP，预测缺失值具有下游价值，但现有方法缺乏可解释的预测依据，且在不同资源水平和特征类型上的性能尚未充分探索。鉴于LLM在元语言推理和提供理由方面的能力，作者希望探索LLM能否更好地完成类型学特征预测。

Method: 采用上下文学习（in-context learning）方法，将URIEL+和Glottolog中的语言数据作为提示，利用系统发育（phylogenetic）和地理（geographic）邻域信息作为证据，评估LLM在零样本和带证据条件下的类型学特征预测性能。

Result: 零样本提示效果不足，但在提供系统发育和地理邻域证据后，LLM显著优于所有基线，且未对低资源语言造成性能劣势。大多数LLM生成的推理与所提供的证据保持一致。

Conclusion: LLM配合证据化的上下文学习能够有效进行可解释的类型学特征预测，为多语言NLP领域提供了一种比传统方法更优且具备解释性的预测途径。

Abstract: Typological features are widely used in multilingual NLP, and the prediction of such features holds downstream utility. However, existing methods to predict missing values lack interpretable justifications for predictions, while their performance across resource levels and feature types remains underexplored. Given LLMs' abilities in meta-linguistic reasoning and in providing rationales, we investigate LLMs' performance in typological feature prediction via an in-context learning approach with linguistic data from URIEL+ and Glottolog. We find that zero-shot prompting is insufficient, but when given phylogenetic and geographic neighbour evidence, LLMs substantially outperform all baselines without disadvantaging low-resource languages. We further find that most LLM rationales are consistent with the provided evidence, offering a step toward explainable typological feature prediction.

</details>


### [160] [IndicSafeEval: Safety Robustness of Large Language Models under Multilingual Persuasive Jailbreak Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03781)
*Saikat Mondal,Mamta,Deeksha Varshney,Oana Cocarascu,Asif Ekbal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了IndicSafeEval，一个针对印度语言的基于说服策略的越狱评估框架。该基准结合了10个安全关键内容类别与6种人类说服策略，覆盖印地语、孟加拉语、马拉地语和旁遮普语四种语言，共生成7,200个对抗性提示。对多个开源LLM的黑盒评估显示，模型的安全表现高度依赖语言和提示的措辞方式，不同风险类别对说服型越狱的脆弱性也存在显著差异，揭示了当前以英语为中心的安全评估的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在多语言场景中的使用日益广泛，但其安全性评估仍主要基于英语进行，导致对低资源及文化多样性语言中对齐失败模式的认知不足。现有安全基准未能覆盖说服式越狱在多语言环境下的表现，亟需一个多语言、跨文化的系统化评估框架。

Method: 构建IndicSafeEval框架：将10个安全关键内容类别与6种人类化说服策略组合，生成覆盖印地语、孟加拉语、马拉地语和旁遮普语四种语言的7,200个对抗性提示。随后对多个开源LLM进行系统性的黑盒评估，分析安全行为在不同语言、说服策略和风险类别间的变化规律。

Result: 模型在不同语言和提示风格下并非表现出一致的安全性：安全性能强烈依赖于所用语言以及基于说服线索的表达方式。不同风险类别展现出不同的脆弱性水平，部分有害内容类型对说服型越狱的敏感性显著高于其他类型。

Conclusion: 当前以英语为中心的安全评估存在重要局限，实际的多语言LLM安全需要引入多语言且具备说服感知能力的基准测试框架，以更准确地评估真实世界中的安全表现。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multilingual settings, yet their safety is still evaluated primarily in English. This limits our understanding of how alignment failures manifest in low-resource and culturally diverse languages. We introduce IndicSafeEval, a persuasion-based jailbreak evaluation framework for Indian languages. Our benchmark combines ten safety critical content categories with six human-like persuasive strategies across four different Indian languages, such as Hindi, Bengali, Marathi and Punjabi, resulting in 7,200 adversarial prompts. We conduct a systematic black-box evaluation of several open-source LLMs to examine how their safety behaviour varies across languages, persuasion strategies, and risk categories. Our analysis shows that the model does not behave equally safely across all languages and prompt styles. Instead, safety performance depends strongly on both the languages used and the way a request is phrased using persuasive cues. We further observe that different risk categories exhibit different levels of vulnerability, with some types of harmful content being significantly more susceptible to persuasion-based jailbreaks than others. These findings reveal important limitations of current safety evaluations, which are largely English-centric, and underscore the need for multilingual and persuasion-aware benchmarking frameworks to more accurately assess real-world LLM safety. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/MonSaikat/IndicSafeEval. Warning: this paper contains example data that may be offensive or harmful.

</details>


### [161] [Evaluating Criterion-Conditioned Behaviour of Large Language Models in Content Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03814)
*Danting Zhang,Bei Peng,Robert Loftin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DECO，一种用于分解内容审核标准的诊断性评估方法，并发现LLMs在聚合标签上的优异表现可能掩盖其在单个审核标准上的严重失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有内容审核基准将多个审核标准聚合为单一标签，导致无法判断模型能否解耦不同审核标准并可靠地逐一应用它们进行决策。

Method: 引入DECO（Diagnostic Evaluation of COntent），一种基于标准的独立因子分解方法，实现对内容在标准层面的受控评估；同时引入成对比较评估方法，用于比较同一输入在不同审核标准下的模型输出。

Result: 在四个审核数据集和四个LLM上的实验表明，强基准性能可能掩盖标准层面的严重失败。当正确决策取决于特定内容方面而非整体有害性时，模型表现最差。

Conclusion: 聚合标签上的强性能不能充分证明LLMs能可靠地按单个审核标准评估内容，呼吁开发明确衡量标准条件化行为的评估方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong performance on standard content moderation benchmarks. However, these benchmarks often aggregate multiple moderation criteria into a single label, making it unclear whether models can disentangle them and reliably apply each criterion when making decisions. To study whether LLMs exhibit criterion-conditioned behaviour, we introduce Diagnostic Evaluation of COntent (DECO), a criterion-independent factorisation of content that enables controlled, criterion-level evaluation. We also introduce pairwise evaluation to compare model outputs across different criteria for the same input. Across four moderation datasets and four LLMs, we find that strong benchmark performance can hide substantial failures at the criterion level. Models struggle most when correct decisions depend not on overall harmfulness, but on the specific aspect of the content that the criterion requires them to assess. Our results highlight a key limitation of current content moderation benchmarks: strong performance on aggregated labels does not provide sufficient evidence that LLMs can reliably evaluate content with respect to individual moderation criteria. These findings call for the development of evaluation methods that explicitly measure criterion-conditioned behaviour.

</details>


### [162] [Beyond Shallow Alignment: How Post-Training Methods Determine Refusal Circuits And Steering Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03887)
*Hoang Cuong Nguyen,Mark Dras,Usman Naseem*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了三种后训练方法（SFT、推理增强微调、偏好优化ORPO）在三类不同架构模型上的拒答（refusal）内部计算机制，发现训练方法重塑拒答的计算方式，但没有任何单一方法能同时实现拒答鲁棒性、保持通用能力和可通过小型编辑修正安全性这三个理想属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对语言模型安全对齐的研究多关注数据层面，而忽略了训练方法本身如何影响模型内部拒答机制的实现方式。理解"拒答如何在模型内部被计算"对于评估安全对齐的可靠性具有关键意义。

Method: 对三种架构不同的模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B、Qwen3-8B）分别应用三种后训练方法：监督微调（SFT）、推理增强微调（在推理链上训练以论证安全决策）、偏好优化（ORPO），随后对模型内部拒答计算的机制进行结构和可操控性分析。

Result: 发现：1) 训练方法（而非仅数据）重塑拒答的内部计算方式，推理增强训练在所有三个模型中产生一致的独特拒答计算类型；2) 架构独立地影响内部结构及拒答被可靠引导的程度；3) 没有方法能同时满足三个理想属性——拒答不集中在少数脆弱组件、安全增益不损失通用能力、安全性可通过小型定向编辑修正。

Conclusion: 作者警示不应将当前后训练方法视为已解决且可靠的防御手段，尤其在安全关键场景中尤为如此。

Abstract: How do the methods used to train language models to refuse harmful requests shape how that refusal actually works inside the model? We compare three post-training methods - supervised fine-tuning, reasoning-augmented fine-tuning (training on reasoning chains that justify a safety decision), and preference optimization (ORPO) - across three architecturally distinct models (Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, Qwen3-8B). We find that training method, not just data, reshapes how refusal is computed internally: reasoning-augmented training consistently produces a distinct kind of refusal computation, visible across all three models, while architecture independently shapes internal structure and how reliably refusal can be steered. Most importantly, no method we study achieves all three properties we would want from safe alignment at once: refusal that isn't concentrated in a few fragile components, safety gains that don't cost general capability, and safety behavior correctable through small, targeted edits. We caution against treating current post-training methods as a solved, reliable defense, especially for security-critical use. Code and models are available in https://github.com/hoangcuongnguyen2001/Beyond-Shallow-Alignment.

</details>


### [163] [CROCODIL: Cross-Model Code Editing with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03894)
*Linghan Zhong,Aditya Thimmaiah,Jayanth Srinivasa,Milos Gligoric,Junyi Jessy Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在编辑由其他LLM生成的外来代码时的行为差异，发现模型倾向于做出更多、往往过度的编辑。为此提出了CROCODIL框架，通过相似性奖励和执�行奖励的乘积来减少过度编辑同时保持功能正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发团队中常使用多个LLM辅助工具，不同开发者偏好不同模型，且同一开发者可能在不同编码会话中切换模型。导致一个模型生成的代码频繁被另一个模型编辑，而这些LLM由于训练数据不同导致代码风格各异，因此需要探究LLM在编辑其他模型编写的代码时是否会产生不同行为（特别是过度编辑问题）。

Method: 提出CROCODIL（Cross-model Code Editing with LLMs）后训练框架。通过相似性奖励惩罚大规模修改，通过执行奖励评分构建和测试的成功率。采用这两个奖励的乘积来引导策略在降低编辑幅度的同时不降低编辑任务的成功率。

Result: 实验发现LLMs倾向于对外来代码进行更多且往往过度的编辑。CROCODIL框架能够有效减少过度编辑，同时保持功能正确性。

Conclusion: LLMs在编辑其他模型生成的外来代码时表现出过度编辑的倾向，CROCODIL通过在编辑大小与功能正确性之间寻求平衡，有效缓解了这一问题。框架代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become ubiquitous tools for code generation and editing. However, development teams often use multiple LLM assistants. Different developers may prefer different models, and individual developers may switch between models across different coding sessions. Because of this, the edits any one model makes are frequently applied to foreign code originally generated by another model. These LLMs are often trained on different datasets, and as a result have different stylistic preferences. Do LLMs behave differently when they edit foreign code originally written by a different LLM with a different coding style? We find that models tend to make more, and often excessive, edits on foreign code. We introduce CROCODIL (Cross-model Code Editing with LLMs), a post-training framework for reducing excessive edits while preserving functional correctness. CROCODIL's similarity reward penalizes large changes, while its execution reward scores build and test success. We use the product of these two rewards to encourage the policy to decrease the edit size without decreasing the edit task success rate. CROCODIL is available at https://github.com/EngineeringSoftware/Crocodil.

</details>


### [164] [RuleMem: Active Rule Memory for Long-Term Conversational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03915)
*Xingyuan Zeng,Zuohan Wu,Quanming Yao,Yue Wang,Wei Liu,Libin Zheng,Jiuke Wang,Jian Yin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出RuleMem，一种基于规则的内存框架，从历史对话中归纳可重用逻辑规则，主动引导证据检索和推理，解决长期对话问答中现有记忆机制被动存储导致的语义缺口和推理不可靠问题。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval_s*基准上优于14个基线，在LoCoMo上超过基线平均27.47个准确率点（相对提升54.3%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期对话问答需要在海量且时间分散的对话历史中进行推理，而现有记忆机制将过去信息视为被动存储的事实，导致语义缺口和不可靠的推理结果。

Method: RuleMem从对话中构建自然语言Horn子句，并通过规则困惑度一致性（RPC）机制验证这些规则。诱导出的规则既能检索语义上相距较远的证据，又为答案生成提供显式逻辑结构。

Result: 在两个长期对话基准（LoCoMo和LongMemEval_s*）上进行全面评估。在LoCoMo上与14个基线进行严格比较，RuleMem取得最高准确率，超过基线平均27.47点，相对提升54.3%。

Conclusion: RuleMem通过主动规则引导的内存机制，有效弥补了被动事实存储的内存局限，在长期对话问答场景中显著提升了推理能力和证据检索效果。

Abstract: Question answering agents in long-term conversations must reason over massive, temporally dispersed dialogue histories. However, existing memory mechanisms primarily treat past information as \textit{passively} stored facts, leading to semantic gaps and unreliable reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose RuleMem, a rule-based memory framework that induces reusable logical rules from historical interactions to \textit{actively} guide both evidence retrieval and reasoning. Specifically, RuleMem constructs natural-language Horn clauses from conversations and validates them via a Rule Perplexity Consistency (RPC) mechanism. These induced rules enable the retrieval of semantically distant evidence while providing an explicit logical structure for answer generation. We conducted a comprehensive evaluation of RuleMem on two long-term conversational benchmarks, LoCoMo and LongMemEval_s*. In a rigorous comparison against 14 baselines on LoCoMo, RuleMem achieved the highest accuracy, exceeding the baseline average by 27.47 points (a 54.3% relative improvement).

</details>


### [165] [Fixed Suffix Dependency Ratio: Quantifying the Dual-Track Mechanism of Gender Assignment in Latvian Loanwords](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03930)
*Yelingyun Zhang,Atis Kapenieks,Marina Platonova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究提出固定后缀依赖比率（FSDR）来量化不同性别对外来词分配中固定派生后缀的依赖程度，从而区分形态锚定与自由选择。通过对1,832个拉脱维亚语名词词条的分析，发现阴性外来词显著更依赖固定派生后缀，而阳性外来词更集中于自由选择区域，该模式具有外来词特异性且在当代使用中更显著。FSDR为检验默认性别提供了定量框架，展示了阳性默认如何在语言接触下被激活和强化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究反复观察到英语借词在不同接受语言中倾向于聚集在阳性性别，但这一模式的起源难以确定，因为固定形态规则和默认分配经常被混在一起分析。作者希望将形态锚定（依赖固定后缀）与自由选择（无固定规则可循）区分开来，以揭示外来词性别分配背后的真正机制。

Method: 提出固定后缀依赖比率（FSDR）这一量化指标，用于衡量不同性别类别对固定派生后缀的依赖程度，从而区分形态锚定与自由选择分布。基于1,832个拉脱维亚语名词词条类型进行实证分析，比较阴阳性外来词在FSDR上的不对称性，并考察该模式的跨时间变化。

Result: 结果显示外来词系统中存在显著的FSDR不对称：阴性外来词对固定派生后缀的依赖显著更高，而阳性外来词更多集中在自由选择区。该模式展现出外来词特异性（非整个语言系统的普遍特征），并且在当代使用中变得更为显著。

Conclusion: FSDR为检验默认性别提供了一个定量框架，证明阳性默认可以在语言接触情境下被激活和强化。该指标能够有效区分形态驱动与自由选择的外来词性别分配，为理解接触引发的语法性别分配提供新工具。

Abstract: Existing research has repeatedly observed the tendency for English loanwords to cluster in the masculine gender across different recipient languages, yet the origin of this pattern remains difficult to determine, as fixed morphological rules and default assignments are frequently analysed together. This study proposes the Fixed Suffix Dependency Ratio (FSDR) to quantify the degree of reliance on fixed derivational suffixes across different genders, and to distinguish between morphological anchoring and free-choice in distribution. By examining 1,832 Latvian noun lemma types, the results reveal a significant FSDR asymmetry within the loanword system: feminine loanwords rely significantly more on fixed derivational suffixes, while masculine loanwords are more concentrated in the free-choice zone. This pattern exhibits loanword specificity and has become more pronounced in contemporary usage. FSDR therefore provides a quantitative framework for testing default gender and shows how masculine default can be activated and reinforced under language contact.

</details>


### [166] [Beyond Majority Vote: Multi-Perspective Adjudication for Medical Hallucination Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03953)
*Joe Cecil,Marjorie Freedman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究针对长文本聊天机器人回复中的事实错误检测展开多视角标注研究，发现单一轮次的幻觉基准会漏算事实错误，多轮审判（multi-pass adjudication）虽能提高覆盖率，但结果仍依赖于评分者的判断、专业知识和证据使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聊天机器人生成的长文本中事实错误往往隐蔽且嵌入在大部分正确文本中，而现有的事实错误检测通常被简化为单次、单标注者的标签问题。要评估检测系统并确保聊天机器人的安全性，需要更全面、更可靠的错误标注方法。

Method: 对医学相关聊天机器人回复开展多视角标注研究，结合三种方法：(1) 首轮标注（first-pass annotation）；(2) LLM作为裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge）进行候选错误发现；(3) 两种裁决形式——医学专家评审和基于证据的事实核查。并将该方法应用于现有基准进行比较分析。

Result: 首轮标注者经常遗漏后续被裁决者验证的事实错误；LLM作为裁判能改进候选发现但仍不充分，会遗漏标注者捕获的错误；不同裁决者之间存在分歧。将该技术应用于现有基准后发现类似模式：单次标注的幻觉基准可能以牺牲完整性为代价实现规模化，导致事实错误被低估。

Conclusion: 在本文所考察的场景中，单次的幻觉基准会低估事实错误。多轮审判可以提高错误覆盖率，但从基准中得出的推断仍然对评分者的判断、专业知识和用于判定错误存在的证据敏感，说明多源候选加上人工裁决并不能完全取代领域判断与专业经验。

Abstract: Understanding the frequency of factual errors in chatbot-generated text and evaluating systems that detect these errors is critical for determining chatbot safety. Yet factual-error detection is often treated as a single-pass, single-annotator labeling problem. In long-form chatbot responses, factual errors can be subtle and embedded within mostly correct text.
  We develop a multi-perspective annotation study of medically relevant chatbot responses, combining first-pass annotation, LLM-as-a-Judge (LaJ) candidate discovery, and two forms of adjudication: medical-expert and evidence-based fact-checking. First-pass annotators frequently miss factual errors later validated by adjudicators. LaJ improves candidate discovery, but is insufficient on its own: It misses factual errors that annotators catch. We also find disagreement among adjudicators, suggesting that adjudication over multiple candidate sources can improve benchmark completeness, but does not eliminate the need to apply judgment and expertise. Applied to an existing benchmark, this technique reveals a similar pattern of missing annotations. Together, these results suggest that in the settings examined here, single-pass hallucination benchmarks may achieve scale at the cost of undercounting factual errors. Multi-pass adjudication can improve coverage, but inferences drawn from the benchmarks are still sensitive to the judgment, expertise, and evidence used to determine error presence.

</details>


### [167] [Two-Stage Reinforcement Learning for Sound and Adversarial Test Generation in Code LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03955)
*Jiacheng Xu,Wentao Zhang,Zhiyi Lyu,Fuxiang Zhang,Chaojie Wang,Yang Liu,Bo An*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TCS（Test Cases Scaling），一个两阶段强化学习框架，利用滚动策略对齐缓冲区自动生成高质量测试用例，作为对抗性RL问题通过反例测试提升代码生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在代码生成中依赖可执行反馈（通常来自具体测试用例），但高质量测试用例稀缺（需同时满足正确性和判别性），因此需要研究利用已学模型自动生成测试用例。

Method: 提出TCS框架，将测试生成建模为对抗性RL问题。两阶段训练：阶段1从滚动策略对齐缓冲区生成与参考解一致的测试；阶段2将缓冲区限制在当前失败模式，学习生成反例测试。两个阶段都从策略对齐缓冲区训练测试生成器。

Result: 在TACO和LiveCodeBench基准上，TCS同时提升了pass@1（贪心解码准确率）和基于生成测试的推理时答案选择性能；学到的测试生成器还能有效改进其他LLM输出的选择。

Conclusion: TCS验证了将测试用例自动生成作为对抗性RL问题的有效性，生成的高质量测试不仅能指导求解器改进，还能泛化到其他模型的输出筛选上。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially advanced code generation with large language models (LLMs) through executable feedback. The feedback for coding problems mainly comes from specific test cases, where high-quality test cases are often scarce since they should be both sound and discriminative. We thus turn to study the auto-generation of test cases using the learned model. We find this is naturally an adversarial RL problem: the model is expected to generate effective test cases as counterexamples, depending on the solver's current failure modes. We propose Test Cases Scaling (TCS), a two-stage RL framework for effective test generation. Both stages train a test generator from a rolling policy-aligned buffer: Stage 1 generates tests consistent with the reference solution, and Stage 2 restricts the buffer to current failure modes and learns counterexample tests. Across TACO and LiveCodeBench, TCS improves both pass@1 and inference-time answer selection according to generated tests. We find the learned test generator also enables effective selection among other LLM outputs.

</details>


### [168] [Investigating the Ability of Large Language Models to Analyze Recipes for Diabetes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03967)
*Revathy Venkataramanan,Aditya Luthra,Venkatesan Nadimuthu,Amit Sheth*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）判断食谱是否适合糖尿病患者的能力，引入了包含7607个食谱（3807个适合、3800个不适合）的基准数据集，并通过三种不同提示策略（直接查询、上下文引导、示例上下文）测试模型性能。结果显示，大多数LLM持保守态度预测，能推理膳食指南的模型表现更好，其中Mistral-7B和Llama 70B表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已有研究显示LLMs在餐食规划方面表现良好，但其判断食谱是否适合糖尿病患者的细粒度分析能力尚未被系统评估。作者希望揭示LLM在检索糖尿病膳食指南、分解食谱成分与烹饪方法并应用指南进行判断这一多步骤推理过程中的能力与局限。

Method: 论文构建了一个包含7607个食谱的基准数据集（3807个适合糖尿病，3800个不适合），设计了三种提示方式：直接查询提示、上下文引导提示和示例上下文提示，分别融入不同级别的医疗来源糖尿病膳食指南信息，以测试多种LLM在食谱适合性判断上的表现。

Result: 结果表明多数LLM倾向于保守地预测食谱为适合糖尿病以避免不利后果。能够基于膳食指南进行推理的模型在预测适合性方面表现更佳。总体上，Mistral-7B和Llama 70B的性能优于其他对比模型。

Conclusion: LLMs具备判断食谱对糖尿病适合性的潜力，提供相关膳食指南作为上下文可以显著提升模型的表现；然而模型在判断中表现出保守倾向，这提示在实际应用中需要特别关注其预测偏差。Mistral-7B和Llama 70B是当前任务中表现最优的模型选择。

Abstract: Several studies have evaluated the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) for meal planning, yielding positive outcomes. These models can process natural language inputs and leverage learned knowledge from their pretraining to generate meal plans. In this work, we investigate the ability of LLMs to analyze the suitability of given recipes for diabetes. The primary challenge for LLMs is to retrieve relevant dietary guidelines for diabetes, decompose recipes into ingredients and cooking methods, and apply these guidelines to determine the recipe's suitability. To study these challenges, we employ three kinds of prompts namely, (i) Direct Query Prompt (ii) Context-Guided Prompt, and (iii) Exemplary Context Prompt that incorporate different levels of diabetes dietary guidelines from medical sources. We introduce a benchmark dataset curated for this investigation consisting of 7607 recipes that include 3807 recipes suitable for diabetes and 3800 recipes not suitable for diabetes. Our results demonstrate that most LLMs are cautious in predicting recipes as suitable to prevent detrimental outcomes. Further, the models that can reason using the dietary guidelines performed better in predicting the suitability of recipes for diabetes. Overall, Mistral-7B and Llama 70B showed superior performance to their counterparts.

</details>


### [169] [Alignment-Free Text-Audiobox for Voice Dubbing and Full-Duplex Dialogue Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03992)
*Sanyuan Chen,Min-Jae Hwang,Sho Inoue,Anna Sun,Bokai Yu,David Kant,Dongmin Hyun,Dorian Desblancs,Gregory Antonovsky,Oleg Repin,Peng-Jen Chen,Xutai Ma,Zehai Tu,Juan Pino,Wei-Ning Hsu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Alignment-Free Text-Audiobox (Text-AB)，一个统一的语音配音与全双工对话合成框架。它基于流匹配目标训练的Diffusion Transformer，在潜在扩散框架中利用DAC-VAE特征实现超高压缩比，采用无需强制对齐的跨注意力机制学习文本-语音对齐，并在48万小时语音上预训练3B参数模型，通过监督微调完成跨语言配音、全双工对话与情感对话三项下游任务，在真实配音基准和对话合成上均显著超越现有系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语音合成系统（如Audiobox）存在三大局限：音频表示压缩率低且重建质量有限；依赖强制对齐和显式时长预测，管线复杂；模型规模与数据量不足，难以支持高质量的全双工对话与跨语言配音等复杂任务。

Method: Text-AB在三个维度上对Audiobox进行改进：(1) 采用潜在扩散框架，使用DAC-VAE特征将48kHz波形编码为25Hz潜在序列，相比EnCodec压缩率提升超10倍且重建质量更好；(2) 对齐无关设计，直接使用现成文本编码器处理原始文本，通过交叉注意力学习文本-语音对齐，去除强制对齐和显式时长预测；(3) 大幅扩展模型与数据，在48万小时单语语音上预训练3B参数模型，并在三个下游任务上监督微调。推理时支持约1分钟语音的一次性生成及基于多扩散方案的任意长语音生成，并通过多阶段重排序策略根据自动指标提升质量。

Result: 在真实世界配音基准上，Text-AB相比最新内部配音系统取得阶跃式改进，在韵律相似度、声音相似度、自然度和可共享性上均有大幅提升。全双工对话合成方面，短对话接近人类录音水平，长对话在人类相似度和表现力上显著超过最新内部模型，同时原生建模话轮转换、反馈语和情感动态。情感对话合成中，情感条件能显著改善情感对齐和情感交互质量。

Conclusion: Text-AB验证了对齐无关的潜在扩散框架在统一语音配音与对话合成任务上的有效性与可扩展性，证明高压缩音频表示与大规模预训练的结合能够带来显著的性能阶跃，为免对齐语音合成和多模态对话系统提供了新方向。

Abstract: We present Alignment-Free Text-Audiobox (Text-AB), a unified framework for high-quality voice dubbing and full-duplex dialogue synthesis. Building on a Diffusion Transformer trained with a flow-matching objective, Text-AB departs from the Audiobox system along three dimensions. First, it operates in a latent diffusion framework using DAC-VAE features that encode 48 kHz waveforms into a 25 Hz latent sequence, giving over 10x higher compression than previous EnCodec representations while improving resynthesis quality. Second, Text-AB is alignment-free: it consumes raw text via an off-the-shelf text encoder and learns text-speech alignment through cross-attention, removing the need for forced alignment and explicit duration prediction. Third, we scale model and data substantially, pretraining a 3B-parameter model on 480k hours of monolingual speech, followed by supervised fine-tuning on three downstream tasks: cross-lingual voice dubbing, full-duplex dialogue synthesis, and emotional full-duplex dialogue synthesis. At inference, Text-AB supports one-shot generation for up to ~1 min of speech and arbitrarily long-form generation via a multi-diffusion scheme, plus a multi-stage reranking strategy that enhances quality based on automated metrics. On a real-world dubbing benchmark, Text-AB delivers a step-change improvement over the latest internal dubbing system, with large gains in prosody similarity, voice similarity, naturalness, and shareability. For full-duplex dialogue synthesis, it approaches human recordings on short-form conversations and substantially outperforms the latest internal model on long-form human-likeness and expressivity, while natively modeling turn-taking, back-channeling, and emotional dynamics. For emotional dialogue synthesis, emotion conditioning significantly improves emotion alignment and emotional interaction quality over the unconditioned baseline.

</details>


### [170] [Representational alignment yields generalizable safety in language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04022)
*Lingyu Li,Yan Teng,Yingchun Wang,Xia Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现当前大语言模型（LLM）对道德概念的"原型分类"能力保持较弱（即在251,334条道德标注上，模型难以区分对立道德类别或保持类别内的典型性梯度），并提出"表征相似性优化"（representational similarity optimization）方法，在不监督生成响应的情况下直接将LLM的潜在表征与人类道德判断中的分类结构对齐。实验表明，标准行为对齐在响应层面"学会"了预期道德判断，但分类结构基本不变且在对抗评估中更脆弱；而重新组织道德分类在显式判断上提升有限，却在多种模型规模、基准和攻击策略下持续提升对抗鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM对齐方法主要优化可观察的响应，但当相同恶意意图以不熟悉或对抗性形式重述时（人类能轻易识别），模型仍然脆弱易受攻击。作者从原型理论（prototype theory）出发，认为人类概念的适应性源于"以中心范例为核心、按典型性梯度分类新实例"的表征机制，而LLM可能缺乏这种道德概念的分类结构，因此希望通过理解并迁移这一表征原则来增强模型的安全性。

Method: 作者首先评估23个LLM中道德概念的原型分类是否得到保留；随后提出"表征相似性优化"方法，将LLM的潜在表征与人类道德判断体现的分类结构直接对齐（而非监督生成文本），并设计匹配实验：使用相同的251,334条人类道德标注数据，对比标准行为对齐与所提方法的差异。在多种模型规模上，用多样化的基准和攻击策略测量显式判断表现与对抗鲁棒性。

Result: （1）在23个LLM中，模型常常无法区分对立的道德类别，或无法在类别内保持细粒度的典型性梯度；该缺陷跨参数规模和对齐阶段持续存在。（2）标准行为对齐在响应层面学习了预期的道德判断，但分类结构基本未改变，且增加了对抗评估的脆弱性。（3）重新组织道德分类在显式判断上仅带来适度提升，但在各种模型规模、基准和攻击策略下均持续改善了对抗鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 研究结果从功能层面支持了"基于原型的分类有助于行为适应性"这一理论观点；同时表明将此表征原则迁移至LLM可在对抗条件下带来可泛化的安全性。这提示对齐不应只关注输出响应，还需关注模型内部表征的分类组织。

Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) is essential for their safe deployment. Current alignment methods mainly optimize observable responses, yet models remain vulnerable when the same harmful intent is recast in unfamiliar or adversarial forms that humans can easily recognize. Prototype theory offers an account of this adaptability. Human concepts are represented around central cases, and new instances are categorized according to their graded typicality relative to these prototypes. Here we show that such categorization of moral concepts is weakly preserved in current LLMs. Across 23 LLMs, models often failed to distinguish opposed moral categories or preserve fine-grained typicality within each category. These deficits persist across parameter sizes and alignment stages. We developed representational similarity optimization, which directly aligns the latent representations in LLMs with the categorization expressed in human moral judgements, without supervising generated responses. In matched experiments using the same 251,334 moral annotations, standard behavioral alignment learned the intended moral judgements at the response level while leaving the categorization structure largely unchanged and increasing vulnerability across adversarial evaluations. Reorganizing moral categorization produced more modest gains in explicit judgements but consistently improved adversarial robustness across model scales on diverse benchmarks and attack strategies. Our findings provide functional support for the view that prototype-based categorization contributes to behavioral adaptability. They also show that transferring this representational principle to LLMs yields generalizable safety under adversarial conditions.

</details>


### [171] [Translation as a Decision Space: A Multi-Agent Perspective on Low-Resource Dialect Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04048)
*Hasan Alkhder,Mohammad Abboush,Igor Tchappi,Ahmet Zengin,Amro Najjar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将神经机器翻译（NMT）重新构建为自主翻译智能体所探索的结构化决策空间，而非仅分析单一输出。在土耳其语-叙利亚阿拉伯语对话翻译任务中，通过三个智能体（零样本直译、方言稳定化微调、英语枢轴翻译）的对照实验，发现轻量级稳定化使方言标记使用率从0.2266提升至0.4988，同时显著降低结构不稳定性，为低资源方言生成提供了可解释性框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NMT系统通常为每个输入仅生成单一输出，掩盖了多语言解码中隐式存在的替代决策路径。这种不透明性在低资源方言场景中尤为严重，因为多种语言学上有效的实现可能在词汇真实性、语域和结构稳定性上各不相同。作者主张将智能体间差异视为可解释的行为信号而非错误。

Method: 将翻译建模为多个自主翻译智能体在共享多语言骨干网络上探索的结构化决策空间。在土耳其语-叙利亚阿拉伯语方向上使用三个智能体：(1)零样本直接翻译；(2)通过轻量级微调实现的方言稳定化翻译；(3)英语枢轴翻译。使用5,000句对话测试，并用5,000对来自电视对话和MADAR-Turk资源的土耳其语-叙利亚语句对进行稳定化训练。通过方言标记频率、与标准阿拉伯语的词汇接近度和结构方差来衡量结构化行为位移。

Result: 轻量级稳定化使方言标记使用率近乎翻倍（从0.2266提升至0.4988），并显著降低了结构不稳定性；枢轴翻译引入了标准化压力和可测量的压缩效应；零样本翻译展现出最高的决策方差。

Conclusion: 翻译智能体间的分歧揭示了多语言模型内部的潜在决策灵活性，为低资源方言生成提供了一个原则性的可解释性框架，超越了传统质量指标评估的局限。

Abstract: Neural machine translation (NMT) systems typically produce a single output per input, obscuring the alternative decision trajectories implicitly available within multilingual decoding. This opacity becomes particularly problematic in low-resource dialect settings, where multiple linguistically valid realizations may differ in lexical authenticity, register, and structural stability. We propose reframing translation as a structured decision space explored by autonomous translation agents. Instead of analyzing a single output, we model distinct translation pathways as agents operating over a shared multilingual backbone. Inter-agent divergence is treated not as error but as an interpretable behavioral signal. We conduct an empirical study on Turkish--Syrian Arabic translation using three agents: (1) zero-shot direct translation, (2) dialect-stabilized translation via lightweight fine-tuning, and (3) pivot translation through English. Evaluation is performed on 5,000 dialogue sentences, while stabilization is trained on 5,000 additional Turkish--Syrian sentence pairs drawn from television dialogue and MADAR-Turk resources. Rather than optimizing for conventional performance metrics, we quantify structured behavioral displacement using dialect marker frequency, lexical proximity to standardized Arabic, and structural variance. Lightweight stabilization nearly doubles dialect marker usage, increasing it from 0.2266 to 0.4988, while significantly reducing structural instability. Pivot mediation introduces normalization pressure and measurable compression effects, whereas zero-shot translation exhibits the highest decision variance. We argue that translation divergence across agents reveals latent decision flexibility within multilingual models and we provide a principled interpretability framework for low-resource dialect generation.

</details>


### [172] [Sequential Beats Joint: On the Interplay between On-Policy Distillation and RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04108)
*Boyan Li,Bingsen Chen,Chenghao Yang,Ping Nie,Chen Zhao,Xi Ye*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"OPD-then-RL"两阶段后训练方案：先用on-policy distillation（OPD）进行稠密token级监督，再用RLVR进行稀疏奖励优化，在逻辑与数学推理基准上一致优于纯OPD、纯RLVR及所有联合训练基线；研究发现OPD负责扩展学生对教师支持解的覆盖范围，RL负责在该覆盖范围内锐化选择，而联合优化两信号会导致干扰，OPD验证分数是切换至RL的关键信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR与OPD是推理LLM后训练的两大主流方法。先前工作尝试在单步内联合优化两者（加权相加或教师调制重缩放RL优势），希望用OPD的稠密token级监督弥补RL稀疏奖励的不足。然而这种纠缠式融合的信号是否真的有效、如何最优地结合两者的优势，仍缺乏系统性理解。

Method: 提出简单的两阶段训练流程：先进行OPD，待学生充分覆盖教师支持的解后切换到RLVR。通过pass@k行为、学习动态、参数更新三个维度对两阶段方案与纯方法、联合基线进行系统对比分析。

Result: 在两阶段方案下，OPD-then-RL在逻辑与数学推理基准上一致超越纯OPD、纯RLVR与所有联合训练基线。机制分析表明OPD扩大学生对教师支持解的覆盖，RL在该覆盖内锐化解的选择；而联合优化两种信号存在干扰。此外发现OPD验证分数是判定何时切换到RL的关键信号，且OPD比SFT更适合作为RL的冷启动。

Conclusion: OPD-then-RL是一种简单且强力的结合方法，将两种纠缠信号转化为互补的阶段，为推理LLM后训练提供了一套可操作且可解释的实践范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have emerged as two dominant methods for post-training reasoning LLMs. Prior work uses OPD's dense token-level supervision to complement the sparse RL reward, fusing the two signals within a single step: either as a \emph{weighted-additive combination} or a \emph{teacher-modulated rescaling} of the RL advantage. In this paper, we show that a simple two-stage scheme, OPD-then-RL, consistently outperforms pure OPD, pure RLVR, and all such joint baselines across logic and math reasoning benchmarks. Beyond the empirical results, we further provide a systematic understanding of this through pass@$k$ behavior, learning dynamics, and parameter updates, yielding a consistent explanation: OPD expands the student's coverage of teacher-supported solutions and RL sharpens within that support, while jointly optimizing the two signals causes them to interfere.To provide a practical recipe, we find that the OPD validation score is the key signal for when to switch to RL, and that OPD is a better cold start for RL than SFT. Together, our results establish OPD-then-RL as a simple yet strong way to combine the two methods, turning two entangled signals into complementary stages.

</details>


### [173] [Last Translation Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04173)
*Vilém Zouhar,Niyati Bafna,Mukund Choudhary,Maike Züfle,Sara Rajaee,Pinzhen Chen,Jannis Vamvas,Sara Papi,Ona de Gibert,Bhavitvya Malik,Eliya Habba,Orfeas Menis Mastromichalakis,Patrícia Schmidtová,Michelle Wastl,Sheriff Issaka,Leshem Choshen,Stella Biderman,Antonis Anastasopoulos,Jan Niehues,Rico Sennrich,Mrinmaya Sachan,Ondřej Bojar,Kenton Murray,Jörg Tiedemann,Alham Fikri Aji,Philipp Koehn,Christof Monz,Alexandra Birch,Sowmya Vajjala,Chalamalasetti Kranti,Cristina España-Bonet,Nobin Sarwar,David Kaczér,Shunta Asano,Malik Marmonier,Daban Q. Jaff,Vaisakhi Mishra,Hend Al- Khalifa,Gabriele Sarti,Sourajit Saha,Nils Rehlinger,Juan Daniel Cuervo Villa,Jonathan Tonglet,Saugata Purkayastha,Dominik Macháček,Jagannathan Ramanujam,Heejin Do,Zuzana Nadova,Fred Philippy,Fabian Retkowski,Maria Lymperaiou,Silvia Casola,Hanna Yukhymenko,Shubhashis Roy Dipta,Sangwon Ryu,Andrés Jerez,Ron Keinan,Shuaib Shuaib Yusuf,Avantica Vempati,Maria Carmen Staiano,Sukannya Purkayastha,Adrian Cosma,Vitalii Babenko,Erivan Inan,Aviral Nigam,Wafa Aissa,Fatima Haouari,Venkata Prasanth Kumar Gummadi,Mehdi Jafarzadeh,Valentin Scourneau,Lukas Edman,Kaiser Sun,Shaomu Tan,Mohammad Sadegh Gholizadeh,Johannes-Rudolf David,Dipankar Srirag,Javier García Gilabert,Ruta Binkyte,Manar Ali,Ana-Maria Bucur,Sabry E. Thunus,Shree Harsha Bokkahalli Satish,Shayan Bali,Prakhar Gupta,Papa Abdou Karim Karou Diallo,Matija Akrap,Marko Culjak,Kristýna Onderková,Joseph Attieh,Esrael Teferi Tensay,Elisabeth Fittschen,Benoît Sagot,Jingwei Ni,Yu Fan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"最后翻译基准"(Last Translation Benchmark, LTB)，一个包含人类编写并经同行评审的多模态(文本、图像、音频、视频)示例集合，专门用于"击破"领先机器翻译模型。每个示例配有手工制作的验证规则，描述具体的失败案例，从而实现可靠且可操作的评估。LTB是一个持续更新的活数据集，当前版本为LTBv1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的机器翻译基准正在趋近饱和，无法再有效区分模型能力；自动翻译评估指标不可靠、易受奖励攻击且无法提供可操作的反馈；即使是人工评估也存在可复现性、客观性和可扩展性方面的缺陷。这些问题阻碍了客观追踪翻译领域进展和识别改进路径。

Method: 构建一个持续贡献的人工作编与同行评审数据集(LTB)，采集能令领先机器翻译模型失败的多种模态示例；为每个示例设计手工定制的验证规则，精确定位具体失败案例，替代传统单一分数式的评估方式。

Result: LTBv1已发布，收录了2026年9月1日前提交并通过评审的贡献，未来将持续发布新版本以扩充数据。

Conclusion: 通过永不饱和的对抗性基准与细粒度验证规则相结合，可以持续追踪机器翻译模型的真实边界，为研究者提供可操作的改进方向，弥补现有基准和评估方法的系统性不足。

Abstract: For scientific progress, we need benchmarks that test the limits of state-of-the-art models, and evaluation methods that inform us about failure cases. As models get stronger, standard benchmarks for machine translation are approaching saturation. Further, automatic translation metrics are unreliable, vulnerable to reward-hacking, and provide unactionable assessments. Even gold human evaluation is not problem-free, because it often lacks reproducibility, objectivity, and scalability. Overall, this prevents us from tracking objective progress in the field and identifying pathways for improvement. We introduce the Last Translation Benchmark, a collection of human-authored and peer-reviewed examples (texts, images, audio, videos) that break leading machine translation models. We also present a new evaluation approach: each example comes with handcrafted verification rules describing concrete failure cases on that example, therefore allowing reliable and actionable future evaluation. The Last Translation Benchmark is a live dataset that accepts ongoing contributions. The latest version is LTBv1, containing accepted contributions prior to September 1st 2026, with future releases planned as new data is continuously collected.

</details>


### [174] [Knowledge Acquisition During Pre-training? Large Language Models Learn Better With Auxiliary Views](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04180)
*Joseph Lee,Yidi Huang,Dokyoon Kim,Shu Yang,Li Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验探究大型语言模型（LLM）预训练中的知识获取机制，提出了"辅助视角"（auxiliary views）——即知识的重述形式——对学习具有因果性帮助的核心观点。研究发现：重复是知识获取的必要条件；在固定token预算下，将文档重复的token分配到辅助视角反而能提升学习效果（即使对事实记忆任务也如此）；辅助视角的有效性并不依赖于生成它们的教师模型强度；并识别出上下文性和基础性两类知识形式有助于弥补先验知识缺口；最后通过逐层偏差与压缩机制揭示了其作用机理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前对LLM在预训练过程中如何获取知识仍存在理解空白。作者提出一个假设：知识的不同表征形式（即辅助视角）对学习具有因果促进作用，但这一机制尚未被系统验证。本文旨在通过隔离控制实验来填补这一认知缺口，从而解释预训练数据多样性为何重要这一问题。

Method: 采用受控实验设计来隔离变量：首先验证重复对知识获取的必要性，并比较释义在何种批大小下有助益；其次在固定token预算下，将文档重复的token重新分配给辅助视角，考察对学习（包括事实回忆任务）的影响；然后改变生成辅助视角的教师模型强度，检验其依赖性；进一步识别有助于在存在先验知识缺口时促进学习的具体知识形式；最后通过逐层偏置和压缩的机制分析揭示这些效应的内在运作原理。

Result: 实验结果证实：(1) 重复是知识获取的必要条件，而释义仅在较小批大小下有所帮助；(2) 在token预算固定的情况下，将token从文档重复分配至辅助视角可提升学习效果，即使对事实回忆任务也存在这种反直觉的提升；(3) 辅助视角的有效性与生成它们的教师模型强度无关；(4) 识别出上下文性和基础性知识形式能在先验缺口存在时促进学习；(5) 这些效应可通过逐层偏差与压缩机制得到物理解释。

Conclusion: 研究结论表明，知识的辅助表征（在大规模预训练语料中自然出现）是预训练成功的关键因素之一，这为"数据多样性为何重要"提供了合理且具有实证支撑的解释。该发现深化了我们对LLM知识习得机制的理解，对预训练数据策略的设计具有指导意义。

Abstract: Gaps remain in our understanding of how large language models (LLMs) acquire knowledge during pre-training. We posit that auxiliary views, reformulations of knowledge, are causally helpful for learning. We design controlled experiments to isolate this. First, we confirm that repetition is necessary for acquisition and clarify that paraphrasing helps only at smaller batch sizes. Second, holding the token budget fixed, allocating tokens from document repetition to auxiliary views improves learning, counterintuitively, even for factual recall. Third, the effectiveness of auxiliary views is not contingent on the strength of the teacher model that generates them. Fourth, we identify forms of knowledge, contextual and foundational, that aid learning in the presence of prior knowledge gaps. Finally, we examine how these effects manifest mechanistically via layer-wise biases and compression. Together, our findings suggest that auxiliary representations of knowledge, which arise naturally in large pre-training corpora, are a key factor in the success of pre-training and offer a plausible explanation for why data diversity matters.

</details>


### [175] [Legibility is Not Interpretability: Comparing Judged and Actual Importance in Chain-Of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04194)
*Kevin Du,Alexander Hoyle,Laura Ruis,Acyr Locatelli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了思维链推理轨迹中推理步骤的重要性是否可以从文本中恢复。作者将推理步骤的重要性定义为优势值（advantage）——即通过蒙特卡洛rollout估计的包含该步骤对期望奖励（如产生正确答案）的改变。实验发现，足够强的LLM判断器能优于流行率基线但远未达到噪声上限；将模型微调为步骤级批评者对错误回答有提升，但对正确回答仍与上限有差距，表明步骤重要性只能部分从推理文本中恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前LLM研究领域大量工作将思维链推理轨迹视为理解模型推理过程的透明窗口，使用LLM判断器对推理步骤进行错误诊断、忠实性评估和步骤级监督（如过程奖励模型、生成式批评者）。这些实践隐含假设推理步骤的文本内容带有其功能角色的信息。然而这一假设是否正确缺乏验证，本文旨在严格检验推理步骤的重要性是否真正编码在文本中。

Method: 本文提出将推理步骤的重要性操作化为优势值（advantage），即包含该步骤导致的期望奖励（如产生正确最终答案）的变化，通过蒙特卡洛rollout估计得到。以此估计为基准，作者评估LLM判断器能否识别高优势步骤，并进一步微调一个步骤级批评者模型来预测步骤重要性。通过比较模型表现与流行率基线和噪声上限，量化从推理文本中恢复步骤重要性的限度。

Result: 实验发现：足够强的LLM判断器可以优于流行率基线，但性能明显达不到噪声上限；微调的步骤级批评者对不正确回答的提升显著，但对正确回答的预测仍与上限有较大差距。这提示推理步骤的重要性只能部分从推理轨迹的文本中恢复。

Conclusion: 本研究的发现为思维链忠实性研究提供了警示性证据：不应将推理轨迹的可读性等同于可解释性。推理文本并不能完整编码步骤的功能重要性，这对过程奖励建模等方法有重要启示，提示依赖文本步骤判断功能角色的实践需要警惕其固有限制。

Abstract: Reasoning traces from chain-of-thought models appear to offer a legible window into how a model arrives at its answer. A growing body of work treats them as such, using LLM judges to diagnose errors, evaluate faithfulness, and provide step-level supervision via process reward models and generative critics. These practices rely on the text of a reasoning step carrying information about its functional role. But does the text actually encode information about which reasoning steps matter? We operationalize the importance of a reasoning step as its advantage: the change in expected reward, e.g., producing the correct final answer, from including that step, estimated via Monte Carlo rollouts. Basing ground truth on these estimates, we evaluate whether LLM judges can identify high-advantage steps and find that sufficiently capable LLMs can outperform a prevalence baseline but fall well short of a noise ceiling. Fine-tuning a model as a step-level critic yields strong improvement for incorrect responses but remains distant from ceiling for correct responses, suggesting that step importance is only partially recoverable from the text of the reasoning trace. Our findings contribute to a growing body of chain-of-thought faithfulness work that cautions against treating the legibility of reasoning traces as interpretability, especially with implications for process reward modeling.

</details>


### [176] [ESPO: Error-Structured Prompt Optimization via Diagnose, Diversify, and Stabilize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04197)
*Lihao Liu,Peng Tang,Kunwar Yashraj Singh,Shabnam Ghadar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ESPO（Error-Structured Prompt Optimization），将提示词优化分解为Diagnose、Propose、Select三个阶段，解决进化式提示词优化器（如GEPA）的提示词膨胀问题。在七个公开NLP基准上相比SOTA平均准确率提升+3.76个百分点（74.67% vs 70.91%），同时提示词缩短47%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 进化式提示词优化器（如GEPA）存在"提示词膨胀"问题：每轮迭代不断追加规则与例外条款，导致提示词长度增长至3倍但准确率并未提升。作者将问题根源归结为三个缺陷：错误观测不完整（incomplete error observation）、搜索多样性不足（limited search diversity）以及选择机制不可靠（unreliable selection）。

Method: 提出ESPO框架，将提示词优化分解为三个阶段：(1) Diagnose：在单轮中将所有训练错误聚类为结构化错误模式；(2) Propose：通过四种互补策略生成候选提示词，每种策略具有独立的偏差；(3) Select：应用bootstrap稳定性选择机制进行可靠的候选筛选。

Result: 在Tweet、MMLU、GSM8K、HotpotQA、ScoNe、HoVer、PUPA七个公开基准上，ESPO平均准确率74.67%，比GEPA（70.91%）高3.76个百分点，且在所有数据集上都达到或超过GEPA。生成提示词平均仅1,004字符（GEPA为1,878字符），缩短47%，推理更快。在Gemma 3 12B、Mistral 14B、Qwen3 32B、Claude Haiku 4.5四个附加学生模型上均取得最佳平均准确率，其中Qwen3 GSM8K提升最大（15.00%→91.40%）。消融实验表明：仅增加多样性而无bootstrap选择反而损害性能（-1.20%）。附录中的泛化界将每个阶段对应测试时差距中的特定项。

Conclusion: ESPO通过结构化错误诊断、多样化候选生成与稳定性选择，有效解决了提示词膨胀问题，在准确率、提示词紧凑性和推理效率上全面优于SOTA，同时其设计在理论上有泛化界的支撑，各组件均有可验证的贡献价值。

Abstract: Evolutionary prompt optimizers such as GEPA suffer from prompt bloat: each iteration appends rules and caveats, producing prompts up to 3$\times$ longer yet no more accurate. We trace this to three deficiencies - incomplete error observation, limited search diversity, and unreliable selection - and propose ESPO (Error-Structured Prompt Optimization), which decomposes prompt optimization into three phases: Diagnose clusters all training errors into structural patterns in one round; Propose generates candidates via four complementary strategies with independent biases; Select applies bootstrap stability selection. On seven public NLP benchmarks - Tweet, MMLU, GSM8K, HotpotQA, ScoNe, HoVer, and PUPA - ESPO improves average accuracy by $+$3.76 pp over the state-of-the-art (74.67% vs 70.91% for GEPA), matching or exceeding GEPA on every dataset while producing prompts 47% shorter (1,004 vs 1,878 chars) and faster at inference. Cross-model experiments across four additional student models (Gemma 3 12B, Mistral 14B, Qwen3 32B, Claude Haiku 4.5) show ESPO yields the best average accuracy on every model tested, with the largest gap on Qwen3 GSM8K (15.00% $\to$ 91.40%). A generalization bound (Appendix) grounds each phase in a corresponding term of the test-time gap, and the ablation confirms a key prediction: adding diversity without bootstrap selection actually hurts performance ($-$1.20%).

</details>


### [177] [Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04199)
*Yuntian Deng,Pengyu Nie,Stuart Shieber*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"compile by training"方法，将自然语言规范编译为可复用的神经函数：利用教师模型在编译期生成任务示例来训练小型适配器，生成的函数无需教师模型即可运行，可存储、版本化并像普通软件一样组合。在FuzzyBench-Hard上达到83.6%语义准确率，编译成本约一分钟，并在多个实际应用中完成部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多重复性文本功能易于描述但难以用规则实现，而每次调用大型远程模型会带来重复的成本开销、延迟以及对外部服务提供商的依赖。需要一个能将自然语言描述转化为高效、可复用的本地函数的方法。

Method: 在编译期利用教师模型生成任务特定的训练示例，用以训练一个小型适配器（adapter），将其适配到一个紧凑的解释器（compact interpreter）上。编译产出的函数在推理时无需教师模型参与，能够像普通软件一样被存储、版本管理和组合。

Result: 在FuzzyBench-Hard（Program-as-Weights快速编译器未能产生任何精确匹配的子集）上达到83.6%的语义准确率。相比快速编译器的数秒，本方法编译成本约为1分钟。已在公开交互服务中部署，并展示了多种编译函数的实际应用。

Conclusion: compile by training在提升编译质量（更高语义准确率）的同时以更高的编译时开销为代价，实现了将自然语言规范离线编译为可复用、无外部依赖神经函数的愿景，并通过多场景部署验证了其实用性。

Abstract: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a provider. We present compile by training, which turns a natural-language specification into a reusable neural function. At compile time, teacher models generate task-specific examples that are used to train a small adapter for a compact interpreter. The resulting function runs without the teachers and can be stored, versioned, and composed like ordinary software. On FuzzyBench-Hard, a subset on which the Program-as-Weights fast compiler produced no exact matches, compile by training reaches 83.6% semantic accuracy. This higher accuracy comes with a higher compile-time cost: roughly a minute rather than seconds for the fast compiler. We deploy the compiler in a public interactive service and demonstrate compiled functions in a multi-site website helper, a language-controlled 3D avatar, and a bidirectional English-Claudish translator.

</details>

### [178] [A Public-Key-Dependent Adversarial-Deletion Ceiling for Fixed-Alphabet Multi-Bit Pseudorandom Codes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02943)
*Frederick Dehmel,Shilun Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究了公钥伪随机码（PRC）在面对依赖公钥的对抗性删除信道时的鲁棒性极限。作者证明了对于固定字母表q≥2，任何单输出解码器的多消息公钥PRC都无法在所有δ-删除信道上保持鲁棒，其中δ>1-γ_q^LCS（γ_q^LCS是两条均匀q元字符串的最长公共子序列归一化渐近长度）。对于二进制情况（q=2），当前最紧的界γ_2≥0.792665992排除了所有δ>0.207334008的常数删除率。证明仅将伪随机性用于将LCS事件从均匀字符串迁移到独立采样的码字，因此碰撞论证本质上是信息论的，不需要秘密密钥。作者还将论证扩展到列表解码场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪随机码（PRC）是密钥错误纠正码，其码字在计算上与均匀字符串不可区分。已有工作研究了PRC在对抗性删除下的表现，但公钥PRC面对同时依赖公钥和具体码字的对抗性删除信道时，其鲁棒性极限尚未明确。本文旨在给出这种设置下无法实现鲁棒性的严格界限，回答"在多消息公钥PRC中，什么程度的删除对抗是无法防御的"这一基本问题。

Method: 本文的核心方法是将最长公共子序列（LCS）的统计性质与伪随机码的语义安全性相结合。具体而言：(1) 利用伪随机性作为传递工具，将均匀字符串上的LCS下界事件转移到独立采样的码字对上；(2) 构造依赖公钥和码字的删除信道，使得两条具有足够长公共子序列的码字被删除后发生碰撞（产生相同输出）；(3) 通过信息论碰撞论证（无需秘密密钥）证明解码器无法在公钥设置下区分碰撞情况；(4) 将单输出论证推广到大小为L的输出列表场景，利用γ_2^(m)=1/2+Θ(1/√m)的渐近行为使阈值趋近于1/2。

Result: 对于固定q≥2，证明不存在多消息、单输出解码器的公钥PRC能对抗所有δ-删除信道，其中δ>1-γ_q^LCS。二进制情形下，δ>0.207334008的所有常数删除率都被排除。对于列表解码，当消息空间包含至少L+1条消息时，输出列表大小≤L的PRC在δ>1-γ_2^(L+1)时无法鲁棒，且随着L增大该阈值趋近1/2。这些界限特指公钥依赖的对抗性信道，不适用于盲（oblivious）编辑信道。

Conclusion: 本文为公钥PRC在对抗性删除下的不可能性提供了第一个定量上界。结果表明公钥依赖的删除信道具有极强的破坏力——删除率略高于均匀字符串LCS的互补阈值即可打破任何PRC的安全保证，且这一结论不依赖于密码学假设（论证核心是信息论的）。这揭示了公钥设置与共享密钥设置在鲁棒PRC上的本质区别，为未来PRC设计中的对抗模型选择提供了理论指导。

Abstract: A pseudorandom code (PRC) is a keyed error-correcting code whose codewords are computationally indistinguishable from uniform strings. We study public-key PRCs over fixed alphabets against adversarial deletions, where the deletion channel may both depend on the public encoding key and the transmitted codeword.
  Let $γ_q^{\mathrm{LCS}}$ denote the asymptotic normalised longest-common-subsequence length of two independent uniform $q$-ary strings. We prove that for every fixed $q\ge2$ no multi-message public-key PRC with a single-output decoder is robust against all such $δ$-deletion channels for any $δ>1-γ_q^{\mathrm{LCS}}$. For $q=2$, the current rigorous bound $γ_2\ge0.792665992$ rules out every constant $δ>0.207334008$. The proof uses pseudorandomness only to transfer an LCS event from uniform strings to independently sampled codewords and therefore also the resulting collision argument is information-theoretic and requires no secret key. We also extend the argument to list decoding: for every fixed constant $L$, provided the message space contains at least $L+1$ messages, no such PRC with output lists of size at most $L$ is robust for $δ>1-γ_2^{(L+1)}$. Since $γ_2^{(m)}=1/2+Θ(1/\sqrt m)$, these thresholds approach $1/2$. Our bounds are specific to public-key-dependent adversarial channels and do not apply to oblivious edit channels.

</details>


### [179] [Privacy-Preserving Heterogeneous Multi-LLM Federated Inference for Cognitive Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02947)
*Yagna Manasa Boyapati,Chong Yu,Tianyu Jiang,Justin Zhan*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个联邦推断框架，使多个商业LLM API（如LLaMA-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3-Haiku）在不访问原始学生数据或模型内部结构的情况下协作完成认知诊断，通过ε-局部差分隐私和基于残差的聚合机制实现隐私保护与诊断准确性之间的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI驱动的教育系统在隐私保护与精准认知诊断之间存在显著挑战：既要保护学生的敏感数据不被泄露，又要保证诊断结果的准确性。传统方法往往在两者之间做出取舍，缺乏在不暴露原始数据或模型内部结构的前提下实现多模型协作的有效方案。

Method: 框架基于异构多LLM架构，包含多个联邦实体（LLaMA-3.3-70B、GPT-4o-mini和Claude-3-Haiku）。每个实体在本地对其预测输出添加拉普拉斯噪声以实现ε-局部差分隐私，随后通过基于残差的聚合方式整合各实体的预测结果，以缓解模型异构性问题。该方法基于诚实但好奇的信任范式，假设API提供商不会滥用提交的查询，差分隐私机制用于保护发布的诊断结果不受外部推理攻击。

Result: 严格的隐私-效用分析显示该方法在提供强隐私保证的同时仅带来极小的准确性损失；在三个教育基准数据集上的广泛真实世界评估证实了框架的实际可用性和跨领域泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该联邦推断框架成功实现了隐私保护与认知诊断准确性的兼顾，通过多商业LLM的协作和局部差分隐私机制，在保护学生数据的同时提供了可靠且可跨领域泛化的认知诊断能力。

Abstract: Significant challenges remain in AI-driven educational systems in balancing privacy preservation with accurate cognitive diagnosis. To overcome this, we propose a federated inference framework in which several commercial LLM APIs collaborate without requiring access to raw student data or proprietary model internals. Using multiple federated entities, such as LLaMA-3.3-70B, GPT-4o-mini, and Claude-3-Haiku, our framework builds upon a heterogeneous multi-LLM architecture. The predictions generated by these entities are combined with epsilon-local differential privacy by adding Laplace noise locally to each entity's prediction output before aggregation, while residual-based aggregation mitigates model heterogeneity. Our approach is predicated on an honest-but-curious trust paradigm in which API providers are presumed not to abuse submitted queries, and our differential privacy mechanism shields the published diagnostic results from external inference. We conduct rigorous privacy-utility analysis showing strong privacy guarantees with minimal accuracy loss, and extensive real-world evaluations across three educational benchmarks confirm the framework's practical usability and cross-domain generalizability.

</details>


### [180] [PrivateHub: Contrastive Diffusion Model for Private Sensor-Intensive Environment Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02958)
*Jiechao Gao,Yuandong Pan,Jie Wang,Michael Lepech,Bradford Campbell*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出Privatehub框架，利用扩散模型中的对比学习生成合成多传感器数据流，在保持非隐私应用可检测的同时隐藏隐私应用，实验表明可将隐私应用识别准确率降低40%-50%而不影响非隐私性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传感器密集型环境通过异构数据流推断用户应用以实现智能服务，但并非所有应用都应暴露——用户希望某些活动保持私密。现有方法如差分隐私和基于规则的过滤仅保护单条数据流，无法应对跨传感器推断带来的隐私风险，因此需要在有用服务推断与非期望推断之间取得平衡。

Method: Privatehub采用两阶段方法：(1) App-Conditioned Pre-training (ACP)阶段，利用应用嵌入对多传感器数据进行条件建模；(2) App-Aware Fine-tuning (AAF)阶段，通过对比学习分离隐私与非隐私数据。此外，论文还定义了多传感器共享场景下的威胁模型。

Result: 在三个真实世界多传感器数据集上的实验表明，Privatehub在保持非隐私应用性能不受影响的同时，将隐私应用识别准确率降低了40%-50%，并且当攻击者在合成数据上重新训练时仍保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: Privatehub有效解决了多传感器跨数据流推断带来的隐私泄露问题，通过生成合成多传感器数据流实现了隐私保护与实用服务推断之间的平衡，且对攻击者的再训练具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Sensor-intensive environments enable many intelligent services by inferring user applications from heterogeneous data streams. However, not all applications should be exposed: users want some activities to stay private. This creates a tension between inferring applications for useful services and preventing unwanted inference. Existing approaches such as differential privacy and rule-based filtering protect individual streams but cannot address the privacy risk from cross-sensor inference.
  We introduce Privatehub, which uses contrastive learning within a diffusion model to generate synthetic multi-sensor streams that keep non-private applications detectable while concealing private ones. Privatehub has two stages: App-Conditioned Pre-training (ACP), which conditions the model on multi-sensor data with application embeddings, and App-Aware Fine-tuning (AAF), which separates private from non-private data via contrastive learning. We also define a threat model for the multi-sensor sharing setting. Experiments on three real-world multi-sensor datasets show Privatehub lowers private-application accuracy by 40 to 50\% without hurting non-private performance, and stays robust when the attacker retrains on the synthetic data.

</details>


### [181] [When Optimization Becomes Manipulation: Defending Generative Search against Malicious Generative Engine Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02964)
*Haozhang Li,Yangguang Shao,Xinjie Lin,Zhong Guan,Mi Zhou,Junzheng Shi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出GEO Defender，一种无需微调目标大语言模型的两阶段防御框架，用于抵御生成式搜索引擎面临的恶意生成引擎优化（GEO）攻击。该框架由Shield Reranker和Training-Free Shield Generation（TFSG）两部分组成，可将平均攻击成功率从50.32%降至6.20%，同时保留94.12%的良性证据使用率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式搜索引擎易被恶意GEO攻击操纵，攻击者通过重写网页文档以匹配引擎的引用偏好，从而影响生成答案的可信度。面临的挑战包括：攻击文档与原文事实一致，使事实验证和困惑度过滤失效；且攻击所放大的特征与高质量良性内容特征相似，难以区分。

Method: GEO Defender采用两阶段防御架构：1）Shield Reranker：在冻结的基础重排器之上学习基于偏好的防御残差，降级GEO改写文档同时保持相关性判断；2）Training-Free Shield Generation（TFSG）：将防御结果提炼为自然语言经验库，指导目标LLM在推理阶段进行来源选择。全程无需对目标LLM进行微调。

Result: 在7种GEO攻击、2个封闭源码LLM和3个开源LLM上的实验表明：平均攻击成功率从50.32%降至6.20%；保留94.12%的良性证据使用率；答案质量保持良好；并能泛化到不可见攻击场景。

Conclusion: GEO Defender有效地应对了GEO攻击防御中的核心难题，通过无微调的两阶段机制在降低攻击成功率的同时几乎完整保留了良性内容的使用，具有良好的泛化能力与实用价值。

Abstract: This paper focuses on defending generative search engines against malicious Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), which rewrites web documents to match engines' citation preferences and thereby manipulates generated answers. Recent GEO methods have advanced from hand-crafted rewriting to automated and agentic optimization, substantially increasing the visibility of target documents in generated answers. However, defending against such manipulation poses two major challenges: attack documents remain factually consistent with their originals, rendering fact verification and perplexity filtering ineffective, and the features they amplify equally characterize high-quality benign content. To address these limitations, we propose GEO Defender, a two-stage defense aligned with the attack chain that requires no fine-tuning of the target LLM. GEO Defender consists of Shield Reranker and Training-Free Shield Generation (TFSG). Specifically, Shield Reranker learns a preference-based defensive residual over a frozen base reranker, demoting GEO-rewritten documents while preserving relevance judgments, and TFSG distills defense outcomes into a natural-language experience library that guides the target LLM's source use at inference. Experiments on two state-of-the-art closed-source LLMs and three open-source LLMs across seven GEO attacks demonstrate that GEO Defender reduces the average attack success rate from 50.32% to 6.20%, retains 94.12% of benign-evidence use, preserves answer quality, and generalizes to unseen attacks from construction instances.

</details>


### [182] [Privacy-Preserving Topology-Guided Safety for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems via Federated Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02967)
*Jinxi Yu,Eric Hanchen Jiang,Levina Li,Dong Liu,Zhi Zhang,Wenxiao Zhao,Yanxuan Yu,Kai-Wei Chang,Ying Nian Wu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出FGLGuard，一种基于图联邦学习的隐私保护多智能体系统安全防护框架。每个运营商在本地对带标注的智能体通信图训练边缘特征图注意力检测器，仅共享模型更新而不共享数据。通过近端局部目标、域平衡聚合、过拒约束阈值校准和加权上游评分等机制，在无需汇集任何私有数据的情况下，跨联邦基准均超过集中式天花板，并显著降低攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于拓扑引导的LLM多智能体系统安全防护依赖图神经网络在智能体通信图上定位风险智能体并干预拓扑，但假设所有带标签轨迹可由单一运营商汇集。然而在跨组织场景中，轨迹包含私有提示、工具输出和专有工作流，任一孤岛都无法看到完整攻击分布，集中式训练假设不成立，需要隐私保护的联邦学习方案。

Method: FGLGuard将隐私保护的多智能体系统防护建模为图联邦学习问题：(1) 每个运营商在本地联合体标注的情节图上训练边缘特征图注意力检测器，仅共享模型更新；(2) 对非独立同分布客户端采用近端局部目标以稳定本地训练；(3) 使用域平衡聚合处理客户端间的分布差异；(4) 引入过拒约束的阈值校准以避免过度拒绝；(5) 采用佐证上游评分机制提升检测置信度；(6) 对拦截的回答执行受保护的改写策略。

Result: 在Agent-SafetyBench、R-Judge和AgentDojo三个基准上，联邦FGLGuard无需汇集任何数据即超过域内集中式上限。在四个不同领域运营商的联邦场景下，达到与多域集中式方法仅差0.03 AUROC的性能，而任何单域防护在其它域上均失效。现有方法迁移在分布偏移下崩溃（AUROC仅0.51，域内再训练后才达0.70）。在线部署的FGLGuard将AgentDojo的真实攻击成功率降低43%，API成本为零，能力损失可忽略。

Conclusion: 联邦学习对于跨组织场景下的多智能体系统安全防护不是可选项而是必要条件：现成的集中式防护转移在分布偏移下会崩溃，可部署的防护必须在每个站点的私有轨迹上适配。FGLGuard证明联邦框架能够在完全不汇集数据的前提下超越集中式训练的天花板性能，同时有效抑制无监督异常防护和本地独立训练所无法应对的跨域攻击。

Abstract: Topology-guided safeguards for LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) train a GNN over the inter-agent communication graph to localize risky agents and intervene on the topology---but they assume one operator can pool all labeled traces. Across organizations that assumption breaks: episodes contain private prompts, tool outputs, and proprietary workflows, and no silo alone sees the full attack distribution. We cast privacy-preserving MAS safeguarding as graph federated learning and instantiate FGLGuard: each operator fits an edge-featured graph attention detector on its own judge-labeled episode graphs and shares only model updates. The method couples a proximal local objective for non-IID clients, domain-balanced aggregation, over-refusal-constrained threshold calibration, corroborated upstream scoring, and a guarded rewrite for blocked answers. Federation is not optional: off-the-shelf transfer collapses under distribution shift (AUROC 0.51 to 0.70 only after in-domain retraining), so a deployable guard must adapt on each site's private traces. On Agent-SafetyBench, R-Judge, and AgentDojo, federated FGLGuard exceeds the in-domain centralized ceiling on all three benchmarks without pooling any data---where unsupervised anomaly guards and local-only training fail. One guard federated across four different-domain operators comes within 0.03 AUROC of multi-domain centralization, while any single-domain guard collapses on the others. Live FGLGuard cuts AgentDojo's ground-truth attack-success rate by 43% at near-unguarded utility, zero API cost, and negligible capability loss.

</details>


### [183] [Privacy Leakage in Federated Learning: Gradient-Based Client Identity Inference and Defenses for Inertial Sensing in Vehicular Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02971)
*Ali Akarma,Toqeer Ali Syed,Muhammad Khan,Qurat-ul-ain Mastoi,Adeel Ahmad*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究了联邦学习（FL）中服务器端客户端身份推断攻击，证明了诚实但好奇的服务器可从模型权重增量中以近乎完美准确率恢复客户端身份。通过裁剪加噪声（clip-then-noise）的差分隐私防御，在sigma∈[0.1,0.2]范围内可将攻击准确率降至接近随机水平，同时FL精度损失不到5%。集成FL可提供1/K匿名集的结构性补充隐私保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着车联网向5G/6G边缘智能发展，联邦学习虽被广泛用于隐私保护训练，但客户端上传的模型更新仍可能泄露客户端身份信息，威胁V2X安全关键场景所需的匿名性，并加剧对抗性ML、模型投毒和后门攻击的担忧。

Method: 使用UCI人类活动识别（HAR）基准作为车载IMU数据流的代理，研究服务器端基于权重增量的客户端身份推断攻击。评估五种攻击分类器和五种非独立同分布（non-IID）数据划分，并采用固定裁剪（C=1.0）配合高斯噪声（sigma∈{0.00,0.05,0.10,0.20,0.50,1.00}）的DP防御，通过Renyi差分隐私核算报告(ε,δ)-DP预算，同时分析集成FL的结构性隐私。

Result: 诚实但好奇的服务器在无防御条件下以近乎完美准确率（约1.000）恢复客户端身份。在sigma∈[0.1,0.2]的实用范围内，攻击准确率降至接近随机水平，而FL相对精度损失低于5%。使用SHA-256加密哈希确保训练/评估梯度不相交，三个随机种子和计数归一化的攻击者优势指标支持结果可靠性。

Conclusion: 研究确认了联邦学习中客户端身份可识别性的具体风险，验证了轻量级DP防御在身份保护与模型效用间的可行平衡区域，并指出集成FL可无噪声代价地提供1/K匿名集下限。论文明确将HAR定位为代理数据集，并提出在真实车载遥测数据上验证的具体要求。

Abstract: As vehicular networks move toward 5G/6G edge intelligence, federated learning (FL) is widely promoted as a privacy-preserving way for vehicles and infrastructure to train shared models without exposing raw sensor data. Yet the updates clients transmit still leak enough information to identify who sent them, which threatens the anonymity that safety-critical V2X applications assume and adds to existing concerns over adversarial ML, model poisoning, and backdoor attacks. We study server-side client identity inference from transmitted weight deltas using inertial (IMU) measurements, evaluated on the UCI Human Activity Recognition (HAR) benchmark as an accessible proxy for the IMU streams produced onboard connected vehicles. Across five attack classifiers and five non-IID partitions, an honest-but-curious server recovers client identity with near-perfect accuracy (approximately 1.000) from undefended updates, confirming a concrete identifiability risk. We then quantify the privacy-utility trade-off of a lightweight clip-then-noise defense by sweeping Gaussian noise (sigma in {0.00, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.50, 1.00}) at fixed clipping (C=1.0), and report formal (epsilon, delta)-DP budgets through Renyi accounting. A practical region (sigma in [0.1, 0.2]) drives attack accuracy to near-random while costing under 5% relative FL accuracy. Ensemble FL supplies complementary structural privacy with a 1/K anonymity-set bound and no noise penalty. Results are supported by cryptographic (SHA-256) train/evaluation gradient disjointness, three seeds, and a count-normalized attacker-advantage metric. We position HAR explicitly as a proxy and discuss what validation on true vehicular telemetry would require.

</details>


### [184] [Boundary-Mutation Testing for Pattern-Based Secret Detection: A Rule-Level Method and Cross-Scanner Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02983)
*Shweta Mishra*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种"边界变异测试"（boundary-mutation testing）方法，用于系统化地改变秘密扫描器中凭据的上下文文本来测试正则规则。通过从各规则自身的正则表达式生成凭据、嵌入真实源代码上下文中，并在规则层面而非工具层面分类结果，得到三个检测指标。在三个扫描器上的实验显示，主要测试对象的检测率在十种上下文中保持≥0.9976，但当凭据以连字符结尾时骤降至0.5233。发现五个受影响规则、Gitleaks的独立缺陷以及TruffleHog无边界脆弱性但覆盖最窄。最终报告的是边际而非条件失效概率，并由于按类型检测为确定性而报告了空结果而非排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于模式（正则）的秘密扫描器通常使用示例驱动的固定装置（fixtures）进行验证，这些装置仅固定文本上下文中的一个变量（凭据周围的文本），导致测试覆盖不足，无法系统性地探索凭据上下文变化对检测的影响。

Method: 提出边界变异测试框架：从每个检测规则自身的正则表达式生成凭据（尤其关注正则边界的字符，如连字符），将生成的凭据嵌入多种真实源代码上下文中，在规则层面而非工具聚合层面分类检测结果，并定义三个检测指标。同时使用边际失效概率（而非条件概率）报告失败情况，并对修复方案进行验证。

Result: 主要测试对象（43规则的开源扫描器）在十种上下文中检测率≥0.9976，但当凭据以连字符结尾时降至0.5233。五个规则受影响：两个带固定计数量词的规则完全且确定性地失败；三个带可变计数量词的规则回溯并匹配到截断的凭据。熵回退机制挽救了部分失败但降级了严重性。Gitleaks存在一个独立的源确认缺陷（硬编码终止符白名单导致大多数凭据类型完全漏检），TruffleHog无边界脆弱性但覆盖范围最窄。修复方案恢复了完全健壮性且无新误报，但一个貌似合理的初步修复静默回归了两个规则。在292,527行真实代码上，误报排序与合成语料库相反。因按类型检测是确定性的，比较单位为10种凭据类型，无召回差异达到显著性，故报告零结果。

Conclusion: 边界变异测试是一种有效的系统化测试方法，能发现示例式验证遗漏的规则缺陷（如正则量词边界问题）。修复验证需谨慎，貌似正确的修补可能静默引入回归，必须通过完整测试套件重新验证。扫描器比较中应基于类型层面的确定性结果报告空结果，而非强行给出排名。采用边际概率报告而非条件概率可更如实反映失效风险。

Abstract: Pattern-based secret scanners are commonly validated with example-based fixtures that fix one variable: the text surrounding a credential. We introduce boundary-mutation testing to vary that context, generating credentials from each rule's own regular expression, embedding them in realistic source contexts, and classifying outcomes at the rule level rather than the tool level, yielding three detection metrics. Applied to three scanners - a 43-rule open-source scanner, Gitleaks 8.21.2, and TruffleHog 3.82.13 - detection in the primary subject holds at >=0.9976 across ten contexts but collapses to 0.5233 when a credential ends in a hyphen. Five rules are affected: two, with fixed-count quantifiers, fail totally and deterministically; three, with variable-count quantifiers, backtrack and match a truncated credential; an entropy fallback rescues some failures but downgrades their severity. We validate a repair restoring full robustness with no new false positives, and report a caution: a plausible first attempt silently regressed two rules, caught only by re-running the same battery. Gitleaks has an unrelated, source-confirmed defect - a hard-coded terminator allowlist causing total misses for most credential types - while TruffleHog shows no boundary fragility but narrowest coverage. We report marginal, not conditional, failure probabilities: one common token format is structurally immune, another fails once in 64; on 292,527 lines of real code, the false-positive ordering inverts relative to the synthetic corpus. Because per-type detection is deterministic, the comparison unit is ten credential types, not hundreds of samples; no recall difference reaches significance, so we report the null result, not a ranking.

</details>


### [185] [AI-Assisted Design of a Post-Quantum Cryptographic Accelerator: A Deployed-Silicon Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04058)
*Jungmin Park,Eunha Kim,Wooseop Kim,Seongjoon Cho,Byungho Cha*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文针对ML-DSA（后量子签名）芯片测试的盲区问题：标准已知答案测试（KAT）因固定种子采样无法覆盖拒绝循环的动态路径，导致范数检查缺陷逃逸。作者提出字节精确黄金参考预言机+随机对抗浸泡的测试门，通过301,343次数据相关签名、零逃逸验证。并报告了232次实验：一个智能体LLM从RTL到PCIe成功驱动ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65加速器，成功率71.6%，最终产物在六个FIPS操作上字节精确，并经受779,945次检查零失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子迁移有强制时间表，硅片缺陷无法远程修补。标准验收门（KAT）无法检测一整类ML-DSA缺陷：签名重采样使执行路径随消息变化，而KAT只采样固定值，仅达到种子触发的深度。作者发现其加速器带有超越块RAM延迟的范数检查缺陷仍通过全部KAT测试，在拒绝循环第5次迭代才暴露。根本问题在于测试工具而非工程师，任何谨慎都无法消除此盲区。

Method: 用字节精确黄金参考预言机配对随机对抗浸泡，驱动拒绝循环超越任何固定向量，从而关闭KAT盲区。同时采用代理LLM驱动统一ML-KEM-768和ML-DSA-65加速器，片上密钥库管理，从RTL开发到PCIe启动全流程，并进行232次记录实验。

Result: 新测试门在301,343次数据相关签名中零逃逸。232次LLM驱动实验中，总体成功率71.6%，成功率呈硬件耦合梯度：文档与研究77-85%，综合与启动仅50-53%（因故障集中在仅物理侧有纠正信号的环节）。最终产品在所有六个FIPS操作上字节精确，部署基线通过779,945次检查零失败浸泡。

Conclusion: 测试门应评判制品而非作者，使信任与作者身份可分离；如此不可靠的AI作者竟能生成在所有六个FIPS操作上字节精确的硬件制品，这一事实本身是核心主张。即AI在困难硬件任务上的产出虽不稳定（可观测性可解释），但其最终制品质量可通过改进后的验收门充分验证。

Abstract: Post-quantum migration is mandated on published timelines, and silicon that ships with a defect cannot be patched remotely. The standard acceptance gate cannot detect an entire class of ML-DSA defects. Signing resamples until a candidate meets its norm bounds, so the executed path varies with the message, whereas known-answer tests (KATs) sample fixed values and reach only the depths their seeds trigger. Our accelerator passed its full KAT regression while carrying a norm check that outran block-RAM latency, leaving each candidate's final coefficients unverified; the escape surfaced at reject-loop iteration 5. The blind spot lies in the instrument, not the engineer; care cannot remove it. We replace that gate. A byte-exact golden-reference oracle paired with randomized adversarial soak drives the rejection loop past any fixed vector, closing the gap: 301,343 data-dependent signings, zero escapes. Because the gate judges artifacts and never authors, trust becomes separable from authorship, making AI authorship an answerable question. We report 232 logged experiments in which an agentic large language model drove a unified ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-65 accelerator with on-chip key custody from RTL to PCIe bring-up on one Kintex-7 XC7K160T, shipped at 98.5% slice occupancy. Success was 71.6%, following a hardware-coupling gradient, 77-85% for documentation and research against 50-53% for synthesis and bring-up, which observability can explain: failure concentrates where corrective signals are physical-side only. That so unreliable an author produced an artifact byte-exact across all six FIPS operations -- its deployed baseline surviving the same 779,945-check zero-failure soak -- is the claim.

</details>


### [186] [Population-Calibrated Graph Screening at 835-Million-Address Scale, with Label-Free Transfer to New Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03036)
*Yury Korolev*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文描述了一个已部署的多链交易图合规筛查系统，通过地址在图中的位置而非监管名单来评分，实现无标签地址的合规筛查。系统基于5条EVM链的8.35亿地址和158亿条边构建异构归纳编码器，双评分头在不同链间无标签转移，在0.1%告警预算下对无标签链召回率达0.818-0.9967，并能在公开封禁前中位528-648天提前发现风险地址。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的区块链地址合规筛查依赖监管名单查表加聚类启发式，对无标签地址和完全没有标签覆盖的链失效。需要一个不依赖标签覆盖、能在多链上泛化的评分方法。

Method: 构建覆盖5条EVM链共8.35亿地址和158亿条边的单一大图；使用带链级归一化的共享归纳编码器，接入两个评分头。决策阈值取全人口评分分布的精确分位数，按链段扫描，使告警量可预先确定。

Result: 无标签迁移：两个链训练的评分头在Base、Arbitrum、Gnosis上对保留正样本召回0.8598/0.8182/0.9967（10^-3告警率）；68个外部注册表事件的静态提前期回放中40/68(58.8%)在0.1%预算下被标记，是事件级随机标记基线的152倍，首次链上出现比公开指定早中位528.8天(Ethereum)/647.8天(Tron)；端到端p50延迟151ms且与离线产物按位一致；8类RL对抗原型通过8项退化审计并暴露部署头的盲区。

Conclusion: 该图位置评分的方法在无标签链上展现出显著提前预警能力和低告警预算下的高召回，且系统在延迟、一致性和鲁棒性方面达到生产可部署标准；但对抗测试仍暴露可被合成的行为规避的盲区。

Abstract: Compliance screening of blockchain addresses is, in practice, a lookup against sanctions registries plus clustering heuristics; it fails on unlabelled addresses and on chains with no label coverage at all. We describe a deployed system that scores an address by its position in a multi-chain transaction graph rather than by its presence in a list. The substrate is a single graph of 835,330,427 addresses and 15,826,261,934 edges across five EVM chains; a shared inductive encoder with per-chain normalisation feeds two scoring heads. Decision thresholds are exact quantiles of the score distribution over the full population, scanned per chain segment, so the alert volume is known in advance. We report: label-free transfer: heads trained on two chains recall 0.8598 / 0.8182 / 0.9967 of held-out positives on Base, Arbitrum and Gnosis at a $10^{-3}$ population alert rate, with no target-chain labels in head training; a static lead-time replay over 68 external registry events: 40 of 68 (58.8%) flagged at the 0.1% budget, $\times$152 over an event-level random-flagging baseline, with first on-chain appearance a median of 528.8 days (Ethereum) / 647.8 days (Tron) before public designation; a serving path whose score is bit-identical to the offline artefact at end-to-end p50 151 ms, gated by a 2,882-address drift panel; and an adversarial harness of eight recurrent reinforcement-learned archetypes that passes an 8-criterion degeneracy audit and, on a detector-independent snapshot, exposes a measured blind spot of the deployed heads against synthesised behaviour.

</details>
