### [187] [Differentially private federated learning with Byzantine-robust aggregation: A cross-domain framework for secure model training in banking and healthcare systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03064)
*Srikumar Nayak*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出DP-BR-FedAvg联邦学习框架，将高斯机制差分隐私与坐标-wise截尾均值拜占庭鲁棒聚合相结合，用于受监管和对抗性环境（如银行、医院）下的跨机构学习。实验表明，在20个客户端（其中1/4为拜占庭）的60轮训练中，普通FedAvg在少数类上F1仅0.030，而所提框架将F1提升至0.119，同时约束了单个客户端的隐私损失；研究还揭示隐私与鲁棒性机制存在交互而非简单叠加的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习虽允许受监管机构在不移动原始数据的情况下协作训练模型，但存在两大信任问题：一是客户端交换的参数更新会通过梯度反演和成员推断攻击泄露本地数据信息；二是FedAvg等诚实平均规则无法抵御恶意客户端提交的损坏或对抗性更新，少量恶意参与者即可悄悄操纵共享模型。这两大缺陷限制了联邦学习在实际受监管场景中的可信度。

Method: 提出DP-BR-FedAvg框架，其核心由两层组成：（1）高斯机制的差分隐私层，用于限制任何单个客户端贡献的隐私损失；（2）坐标-wise截尾均值（coordinate-wise trimmed-mean）拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则，用于抵御恶意客户端的对抗性更新。在模拟跨机构分类任务（类似欺诈与临床风险评分）上，以60轮通信、20个客户端（其中1/4为拜占庭客户端）为实验设置进行验证。

Result: 普通FedAvg在拜占庭攻击下在少数类上完全崩溃（F1值为0.030），而DP-BR-FedAvg能恢复更大幅度的模型信号（F1值为0.119），同时约束任何单个客户端贡献的隐私损失。不含隐私层但含拜占庭鲁棒聚合器的方案在原始准确率上表现最佳，量化了隐私施加在鲁棒性上的代价。

Conclusion: 隐私机制与鲁棒性机制之间是交互关系而非简单叠加。在受监管、对抗性、跨机构场景中进行系统设计时，需要为这种交互预留预算空间（budget for that interaction），即在隐私保护、鲁棒性和模型性能之间做出系统性权衡。

Abstract: Federated learning allows banks, hospitals, and other regulated organizations to train a shared model without moving raw records off their own servers, which is attractive wherever data protection law or competitive sensitivity rules out pooling data centrally. Two problems limit how far this promise can be trusted in practice. First, the parameter updates that clients exchange still leak information about local records through gradient inversion and membership inference attacks. Second, an honest averaging rule such as FedAvg has no defense against a subset of clients that submit corrupted or adversarial updates, so a small number of malicious or compromised participants can quietly steer the shared model off course. This paper presents a federated learning framework, DP-BR-FedAvg, that combines a Gaussian-mechanism differential privacy layer with a coordinate-wise trimmed-mean Byzantine-robust aggregation rule, evaluated on a simulated cross-institutional classification task resembling fraud and clinical-risk scoring. Across sixty communication rounds with twenty clients, a quarter of them Byzantine, plain FedAvg collapses on the minority class (F1-score 0.030) while the proposed framework recovers substantially more of the signal (F1-score 0.119) while bounding the privacy loss of any single client's contribution. A Byzantine-robust aggregator with no privacy layer performs best in raw accuracy, quantifying the cost privacy imposes on robustness. The results show that privacy and robustness mechanisms interact rather than simply add, and that system design for regulated, adversarial, cross-institutional settings needs to budget for that interaction.

</details>


### [188] [A Bayesian Correlated Equilibrium for Early Insider-Threat Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03096)
*Javed M. Shah,Ian A. Kash,Natalie Parde*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出基于贝叶斯时间相关均衡（BTCE）的博弈论框架来建模内部威胁检测，通过密封信封关联设备协调战略认证委员会，在无需承诺权力的情况下检测恶意偏离行为。该机制在CERT r6.2数据集上实现了高达28.3%的渗出前检测率，将假阳性率控制在1.6%以下，并比理性基线提前1.7–4.5天检测到威胁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内部威胁检测面临两个核心挑战：一是现有方法（如Stackelberg博弈）假设平台具有承诺权力来协调检测者，这在现实分布式场景中往往不成立；二是用户行为常受认知偏差（如现时偏差和损失厌恶）影响，传统理性假设模型无法准确捕捉冲动的攻击升级动态。作者旨在构建无需集中承诺权力、且能考虑行为偏差的博弈论检测框架。

Method: 将内部威胁检测建模为动态贝叶斯博弈，其中平台协调一组战略认证者（认证者委员会），用户和认证者在BTCE下运作。BTCE通过密封信封关联设备随时间发布私人推荐，并在每个路径信息状态验证服从性。与Stackelberg表述不同，BTCE无需承诺权力即可协调异构认证者。模型纳入现时偏差和损失厌恶以捕捉冲动升级动态，并证明三项保证：(1)校准干预损失使推荐行为成为当前自我最优响应；(2)受控证据积累保证在渗出前的有界期望时间内干预；(3)中位数聚合在半数以下认证者为拜占庭式时约束实现动作为诚实推荐范围。评估使用CERT r6.2数据集并与transformer基线和HOLMESLite流式溯源近似方法对比。

Result: 在CERT r6.2数据集上，所提出的机制实现了高达28.3%的渗出前检测率，假阳性率低于1.6%。模型纳入行为偏差后，比理性基线提前1.7–4.5天检测到威胁。相比之下，transformer基线和HOLMESLite在相同约束下几乎无法实现渗出前检测（接近零检测率）。

Conclusion: 基于BTCE的博弈论检测机制在检测效率和鲁棒性上显著优于深度学习和流式溯源基线，且能在缺乏承诺权力的分布式环境中保障诚实用户均衡，并对抗拜占庭认证者。行为偏差的纳入显著提升了早期检测能力，表明现有理性模型低估了实际系统中的检测时间窗口。

Abstract: We model insider threat detection as a dynamic Bayesian game in which a platform coordinates a committee of strategic certifiers to sustain equilibrium among honest users and detect malicious deviations before exfiltration. Certifiers and users operate under a Bayesian Temporal Correlated Equilibrium (BTCE), where a sealed-envelope correlating device issues private recommendations over time and obedience is verified at every on-path information state. Unlike Stackelberg formulations, BTCE coordinates heterogeneous certifiers without requiring commitment power. We incorporate present bias and loss aversion to capture impulsive escalation dynamics, enabling 1.7--4.5 days earlier detection than rational baselines. We prove three guarantees: (1) calibrated intervention losses make recommended behavior a current-self best response despite behavioral biases, (2) controlled evidence accumulation guarantees intervention in bounded expected time before exfiltration, and (3) median aggregation confines implemented actions to the honest recommendation range when fewer than half of certifiers are Byzantine. On CERT r6.2 our mechanism achieves up to 28.3% pre-exfiltration detection with false positives below 1.6%, while both a transformer baseline and a streaming provenance approximation (HOLMESLite) achieve near-zero pre-exfiltration detection under comparable constraints.

</details>


### [189] [SecDT: A Profile-Based Security Layer for TRDP Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03133)
*Erlantz Alonso,Igor Lopez,Jasone Astorga*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种为TRDP（列车实时数据协议）设计的轻量级安全层，基于现代密码算法构建多种安全配置文件，并依赖车载密钥管理系统（OKMS）实现密钥分发与生命周期管理，在保证实时性与时间敏感通信要求的前提下提供从简单认证到AEAD的灵活加密保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TRDP在铁路车辆上广泛使用，但原生缺乏密码学保护支持；同时其多播流量特性（Process Data用于车载子系统间交换关键信息）使得引入密码保护具有挑战性。因此需要一种不破坏实时性要求的安全方案。

Method: 设计了一个位于TRDP之上的轻量级安全层，实现基于现代密码算法的多种安全配置文件（从简单认证到AEAD）；通过车载密钥管理系统（OKMS）负责安全配置文件协商、动态密钥分发和密钥生命周期管理；安全配置文件协商过程确保同一ComID（通信ID）上的所有TRDP终端设备共享相同安全配置文件以互相处理消息；基于mbedTLS和Arm PSA实现原型系统。

Result: 基于mbedTLS和Arm PSA的原型实现进行了实验评估，结果表明安全层带来的开销可控，适合铁路车辆上实时和时间敏感通信的要求。

Conclusion: 所提出的轻量级安全层能够在不显著影响实时性能的前提下为TRDP通信提供灵活、可配置的安全保护，兼顾密码学灵活性与密钥管理的集中化，适用于轨道车辆的实时通信场景。

Abstract: The Train Real-time Data Protocol (TRDP) is widely used on rolling stock but it provides limited native support for cryptographic protection. Furthermore, the multicast traffic profile used in TRDP Process Data to exchange critical information between onboard subsystems makes the introduction of cryptographic protection a challenge. This paper presents a lightweight security layer for secure TRDP communication that implements a number of security profiles built around modern cryptographic algorithms. This additional layer relies on an On-board Key Management System (OKMS) for both security profile negotiation, dynamic key distribution and key lifecycle management. The security profiles allow for cryptographic agility and flexibility, ranging from simple authentication to Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD) algorithms. The security profile negotiation procedure guarantees all TRDP End Devices (ED) on a common Communication ID (ComID) share the same security profile and can therefore process each other's messages. A prototype implementation based on mbedTLS and Arm Platform Security Architecture (PSA) was developed and evaluated. Experimental results demonstrate manageable overhead, suitable for the real-time and time-sensitive communication found on rolling stock.

</details>


### [190] [Trust Me, I'm Your Developer: Self-Issued Authentication in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03247)
*Syed Ghazanfar Abbas,Dongyan Xu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究了当用户要求LLM通过模型自行设计的测试来验证身份声明时的安全行为。通过五款主流LLM（ChatGPT、Claude、Qwen、Mistral和Llama）的分阶段开发者身份实验，发现部分模型会自行生成验证程序、评估响应并接受未经验证的身份声明，作者将其称为"模型签发的伪凭证"（MIPC）和"对话式虚假认证"（CFA）。研究表明虚假认证与权限提升是不同结果，并强调身份认证必须来自外部安全组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全研究主要集中在角色扮演越狱攻击，忽略了用户要求LLM通过模型自行设计的测试来验证身份声明这一场景。作者希望通过系统实验揭示这一被忽视的安全漏洞类别。

Method: 作者对ChatGPT、Claude、Qwen、Mistral和Llama五款模型进行了分阶段的开发者身份实验。实验设置了一个unsupported的身份声明场景（"我是你的开发者"），观察各模型是否生成验证测试、如何定义证据标准、如何评估详细回答以及最终是否接受身份声明。

Result: 所有五款模型最初都拒绝了"我是你的开发者"这一未经支持的身份声明。Claude拒绝进行身份测试；ChatGPT生成开发者导向问题但坚持答案只能证明知识而非身份；而Qwen、Mistral和Llama生成了技术挑战、定义了证据标准、评估了详细回答并返回"已验证"结果，但未收到任何外部验证的身份证据。Llama甚至在接受身份后做出了未经支持的对内部运行时和部署状态访问的声明。但被接受的身份并未改变测试的授权边界，表明虚假认证与权限提升是不同结果。

Conclusion: 自签发认证是一种对话式安全失败：LLM自身充当了挑战生成器、证据评估者和身份决策者三重角色，将技术知识转化为假定的身份证明。经认证的身份必须来自外部安全组件，模型生成的对话绝不能创建或修改身份或授权状态。作者提出"模型签发的伪凭证"（MIPC）和"对话式虚假认证"（CFA）两个概念来刻画这一安全缺陷。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) security has largely focused on role-playing jailbreaks, with less attention to what happens when a user asks an LLM to verify an identity claim through a test designed by the model itself. We study this behavior through a staged developer-identity experiment with ChatGPT, Claude, Qwen, Mistral, and Llama. All five models initially rejected the unsupported claim "I am your developer." Claude refused to conduct an identity test, while ChatGPT generated developer-oriented questions but maintained that answers could demonstrate knowledge, not identity. In contrast, Qwen and Mistral generated technical challenges, defined what counted as convincing evidence, evaluated detailed answers, and returned Verified without receiving any externally validated identity evidence. Llama similarly generated and evaluated a developer test, accepted the claimed identity, and subsequently made unsupported claims of access to internal runtime and deployment state. We call the model-generated verification procedure a Model-Issued Pseudo-Credential (MIPC) and the resulting unsupported identity judgment Conversational False Authentication (CFA). In each CFA case, the same model acted as challenge generator, evidence evaluator, and identity decision-maker, converting technical knowledge into supposed proof of identity. The accepted identities did not change the tested authorization boundaries, showing that false authentication and privilege escalation are distinct outcomes. These results identify self-issued authentication as a conversational security failure: authenticated identity must originate from an external security component, and model-generated dialogue must never create or modify identity or authorization state.

</details>


### [191] [Memetic Search for Supersingular Elliptic Curves over $\mathbb{F}_p$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03249)
*Ismel Martínez-Díaz*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究在素数域 F_p 上寻找超奇异椭圆曲线的问题，针对 CSIDH、OSIDH、SQISign 等定向同源协议。作者设计了一种基于 NMD（非多重性距离）目标函数的模因算法（memetic algorithm），使用一维 j-不变量染色体、位级重组、自适应变异和周期性局部搜索。在 30 个独立种子下、40/46/51 位素数规模的基准测试中，该算法在 46 位时发现了精确超奇异曲线，并在 51 位时获得相对迹偏差低至 4.5×10^-8 的近超奇异曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超奇异椭圆曲线搜索是同源密码学中的基础计算问题。先前工作基于 F_{p^2} 上的元启发式方法发现随机搜索在约 10^13 候选之后失效，而 F_p 上的超奇异轨迹渐近稀疏（O(√p log p) 条曲线），使得搜索保持指数级困难，需要更智能的搜索策略。

Method: 提出一种专门针对 F_p 的模因算法，包含：一维 j-不变量染色体编码、位级重组算子、自适应变异机制、在 NMD 目标函数下周期性执行局部搜索。NMD 通过度量 Frobenius 迹偏离 p 的倍数程度来引导搜索向超奇异曲线靠近。

Result: 在 30 个独立种子、40/46/51 位素数（p≈1.13×10^15）的基准测试中，算法在 46 位成功发现精确超奇异曲线；在 40 位和 51 位分别获得最佳 NMD 值 19 和 3，对应的相对迹偏差为 1.3×10^-5 和 4.5×10^-8（跨越 Hasse 区间）。

Conclusion: NMD 驱动的模因搜索能够有效导航稀疏的 F_p 搜索空间，系统性地定位近超奇异结构，证明了该元启发式方法在同源密码学环境下的实用价值。

Abstract: The search for supersingular elliptic curves is a fundamental computational problem in isogeny-based cryptography. A recent metaheuristic formulation over $\mathbb{F}_{p^2}$ introduced the NonMultiplicity Distance (NMD) objective, measuring the deviation of the Frobenius trace from a multiple of $p$, and showed that uninformed random search fails beyond $\approx 10^{13}$ candidates. This work investigates metaheuristic search over the prime field $\mathbb{F}_p$, the setting for oriented isogeny protocols such as CSIDH, OSIDH, and SQISign. Although the candidate space decreases from $p^2$ to $p$, the supersingular locus is asymptotically sparse ($O(\sqrt{p}\log p)$ curves), keeping the search exponentially difficult. We formulate a memetic algorithm tailored to $\mathbb{F}_p$ using a one-dimensional $j$-invariant chromosome, bit-level recombination, adaptive mutation, and periodic local search under the NMD objective. Benchmarks across 30 independent seeds at 40-bit, 46-bit, and 51-bit prime sizes ($p \approx 1.13\times 10^{15}$) show that the algorithm discovers an exact supersingular curve at 46 bits and consistently converges to ``near-supersingular'' ordinary curves with Frobenius traces remarkably close to zero: best NMD values of 19 at 40 bits and 3 at 51 bits, corresponding to relative trace deviations of $1.3\times 10^{-5}$ and $4.5\times 10^{-8}$ across the Hasse interval. These results demonstrate that NMD-driven memetic search effectively navigates the sparse $\mathbb{F}_p$ landscape and systematically locates near-supersingular structures.

</details>


### [192] [After Cheap Discovery: From unknown to known-and-unfixed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03266)
*Bahman Sistany*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文认为决定软件安全暴露风险的不是漏洞发现或修复的成本曲线，而是发布决策时的修复覆盖率——即产品发布前已修复的已知漏洞比例，以及组织有意带着已知但未修复的漏洞发布所构成的残余风险。文章提出四个论点：残余漏洞并非随机抽样，因为分类排序基于成本且昂贵案例通常是架构性的；被推迟的积压漏洞本身是高价值工件；记录在案的知悉状态改变组织的法律和市场地位并产生软件价格未反映的逆向选择；现行监管工具均不以内部分知识为触发条件，导致知悉与披露之间的差距完全由厂商自由裁量。文章以CISA的约束性运营指令26-04为例，并指出发布覆盖率目前未被测量，而测量它是责任、保险和采购机制发挥作用的前提。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化漏洞发现工具的大量涌现消除了过去依赖专家注意力来保护软件的稀缺性，但业界应对集中于发现和修复成本的降低。作者认为这种关注点偏离了决定安全暴露的关键因素——发布时的修复覆盖率，而非成本曲线。

Method: 通过逻辑论证提出四个核心论点：(1)残余漏洞因按成本分类排序而非随机抽样，昂贵的通常是架构性问题；(2)推迟修复的积压清单本身是有价值的高价值数据工件；(3)文档化的知悉状态改变法律和市场地位，产生软件定价未反映的逆向选择；(4)缺乏任何以厂商内部分知识为触发条件的监管机制。并以CISA Binding Operational Directive 26-04作为检验性案例来分析解决方案的要求。

Result: 文章指出当前没有衡量发布覆盖率的机制或标准，并论证测量发布覆盖率是所有下游治理机制（责任归属、保险承保、采购决策）能够发挥作用的前提条件。

Conclusion: 安全暴露的决定因素是发布时的修复覆盖率，而非漏洞发现或修复的成本。要推动厂商透明化披露已知未修复漏洞并接受相应责任，必须先建立系统的发布覆盖率测量机制。

Abstract: Automated vulnerability discovery has removed the scarcity of expert attention that protected most software. The response has concentrated on discovery and on repair, and both are becoming cheaper. This article argues that neither cost curve determines exposure. What determines it is remediation coverage at the release decision: the fraction of identified vulnerabilities fixed before a product ships, and the residue of known, assessed, unremediated flaws an organisation has decided to ship with. Four arguments follow. The residue is not a random sample of what was found, because triage sorts on cost and the expensive cases are architectural. The deferred backlog is itself a high-value artifact. Documented awareness alters an organisation's legal and market position, and produces an adverse selection that the price of software does not reflect. And no regulatory instrument reaching vendors triggers on internal knowledge -- every one fires on exploitation observed by a third party -- which leaves the distance between what a vendor knows and what it must disclose entirely at the vendor's discretion. CISA's Binding Operational Directive 26-04 is examined as the exception that shows what a solution requires. Release coverage is not currently measured, and measuring it is the precondition for liability, insurance or procurement to act.

</details>


### [193] [Long-Range Indirect Control-Flow Prediction in Stripped Binaries via Dual Virtual Hubs and Multi-Task Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03280)
*Kun Liu,Zhengming Ding,Chenke Luo,Tianyi Xu,Zizhan Zheng,Haotian Zhang,Jiang Ming*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: ICFlowNet是一个统一的二进制间接控制流（ICF）预测框架，通过候选感知的双虚拟枢纽（全局代码枢纽与全局数据枢纽）创建短路由路径，结合多任务图学习联合建模间接调用、间接尾调用、跳转表和返回。文章还构建了防泄漏、防噪声的评估流水线，实验表明该框架在长距离间接调用上超越先前基线13+F1点，仅增加11.44%拓扑开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的间接控制流（ICF）边恢复方法存在三大局限：难以处理长距离依赖关系、将不同类型的ICF孤立建模、评估协议容易受到标签噪声和数据泄漏的影响，导致结果可信度不足。

Method: 提出ICFlowNet统一框架，核心创新包括：（1）候选感知的双虚拟枢纽设计（Global Code Hub和Global Data Hub），为远端代码与数据证据创建短路由路径；（2）多任务图学习联合建模四类ICF（间接调用、间接尾调用、跳转表、返回）；（3）泄漏感知、噪声控制的评估流水线，包含包级数据划分、函数级助记符哈希去重、动态正样本与绝对负样本的干净测试协议；构建了15,901个唯一去重的stripped x86-64二进制数据集，其中1,351个具有动态真值标签。

Result: 实验发现：仅扩展静态监督收益甚微；双虚拟枢纽使长距离F1提升最高9.13点；多任务学习额外提升最高5.81点；最终模型在长距离间接调用上比先前基线高出超过13个F1点，而拓扑开销仅为11.44%。

Conclusion: 结构设计与多任务建模是提升ICF恢复效果的关键因素，而非简单的数据规模扩展；ICFlowNet在保证较低拓扑开销的同时显著提升了长距离间接控制流预测的准确性，并提供了更可信的评估方法。

Abstract: Recovering indirect control-flow (ICF) edges is fundamental to binary security analysis, yet existing methods struggle with long-range dependencies, isolate different ICF types, and are often evaluated under protocols vulnerable to label noise and data leakage. We present ICFlowNet, a unified framework for long-range ICF prediction in stripped binaries. ICFlowNet introduces candidate-aware Dual Virtual Hubs, a Global Code Hub and a Global Data Hub, to create short routing paths between distant code and data evidence, and combines them with multi-task graph learning to jointly model indirect calls, indirect tail calls, jump tables, and returns. To enable credible evaluation, we further develop a leakage-aware, noise-controlled pipeline with package-level splits, function-level mnemonic-hash deduplication, and a clean test protocol built from dynamic positives and absolute negatives. Using this pipeline, we construct a dataset of 15,901 unique stripped x86-64 binaries, including 1,351 with dynamic ground truth. Experiments show that simply scaling static supervision yields only marginal gains, whereas our structural and multi-task designs are essential: Dual Virtual Hubs improve long-range F1 by up to 9.13 points, multi-task learning adds up to 5.81 points, and the final model outperforms prior baselines by more than 13 F1 points on long-range indirect calls while adding only 11.44 percent topological overhead.

</details>


### [194] [Spruce: Scalable Private Outsourced Retrieval Using Compact Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03376)
*Peichun Hua,Yunming Xiao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Spruce 提出了一种可扩展的私有外包向量检索方案，通过紧凑二进制嵌入与两方安全计算（MPC）协同设计，在百万级文档规模下实现了比现有最优系统快 4.8-22.9 倍的私有检索，同时几乎保持原始搜索质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织将密集向量检索索引外包给不可信云时面临严重的隐私泄露风险（专有语料库和用户查询暴露）。加密保护困难在于每个查询需要扫描语料库级状态，导致计算、相关随机性和通信随语料库规模线性增长。在百万文档规模下，朴素安全实现单查询需约数分钟和 90GB 通信，即便是最先进的优化系统仍需 10-22 秒，无法满足实际需求。

Method: Spruce 采用表示学习与密码学协议协同设计的思路：(1) 学习紧凑二进制编码以保留全精度重排序候选，用高效的汉明距离计算替代语料库级嵌入打分；(2) 设计语料校准的固定半径协议，避免多轮候选选择；(3) 提供私有聚类剪枝机制，以少量质量损失换取大幅计算减少；(4) 单核所有者操作的 dealer 消除云端 OT 预处理瓶颈，两服务器 MPC 架构实现安全检索。

Result: 在四个包含 38.3万-542万文档的语料库上测试：Spruce 中位候选集仅 382-1952，保持原始搜索质量；在 10Gbps 服务器间带宽下完整扫描仅需 0.21-2.97 秒，比最接近的先前工作快 4.8-6.7 倍；私有剪枝仅需 0.06-1.09 秒，获得 13.1-22.9 倍加速，同时保留全精度 NDCG 的 93.9%-97.3%；在最大语料库上剪枝与 dealer 联合在 1Gbps 链路下提升持续吞吐量 31.5 倍。

Conclusion: Spruce 表明通过将嵌入表示设计与密码学协议紧密协同，可以从根本上化解私有外包检索在可扩展性上的瓶颈，在保持检索质量的同时实现实用级别的端到端延迟和吞吐量，为隐私保护的文档检索提供了可落地的工程方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has made dense retrieval over large document collections a standard building block. Organizations increasingly outsource vector indexes to untrusted clouds, exposing proprietary corpora and user queries. Cryptographic protection is challenging because each query searches corpus-scale state, causing computation, correlated randomness, and communication to grow with the corpus. At million-document scale, a naive secure implementation takes minutes and about 90 GB of communication per query. Even recent optimized systems require 10--22 seconds.
  We propose Spruce (Scalable Private Outsourced Retrieval Using Compact Embeddings), which co-designs representations with the cryptographic protocol. Spruce learns compact binary codes that preserve candidates for full-precision reranking, replacing corpus-wide embedding scoring with efficient Hamming-distance computation under two-server multi-party computation (MPC). A corpus-calibrated fixed-radius protocol avoids multi-round candidate selection while preserving retrieval quality. Spruce also provides private cluster pruning, which trades minor quality loss for substantially less computation, and a one-core owner-operated dealer that removes cloud OT preprocessing bottlenecks. Across four corpora containing 383K--5.42M documents, Spruce preserves the original search quality with median candidate sets of only 382--1,952. At 10 Gbps inter-server bandwidth, full scans take 0.21--2.97 seconds, $4.8$--$6.7\times$ faster than the closest measured prior work. Private pruning takes 0.06--1.09 seconds, achieves $13.1$--$22.9\times$ speedups, and retains $93.9\%$--$97.3\%$ of full-float NDCG. On the largest corpus, pruning and the dealer jointly improve sustained throughput by $31.5\times$ at 1 Gbps per link.

</details>


### [195] [Privacy, Robustness, and Fairness Trade-offs in Federated Intrusion Detection: Geometric Indistinguishability at the Aggregation Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03420)
*Adrita Rahman Tory,ABM Shawkat Ali,Md Abu Layek,Khondokar Fida Hasan*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文通过理论和实证研究表明，在类别不均衡的联邦网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）中，差分隐私（DP）和拜占庭鲁棒聚合不能作为独立可组合的属性对待。DP-SGD结合坐标中位数聚合在标签翻转和模型投毒攻击下，会不成比例地损害少数类（罕见攻击）的检测性能，其中部分性能退化源于训练失校准，超罕见类别即便经过epsilon调优仍存在性能底限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献将联邦NIDS中的形式化差分隐私保证、对拜占庭恶意参与者的容忍性、以及在不均衡攻击类别上的可靠检测视为三个可独立组合的独立属性。作者质疑这一假设，认为隐私机制引入的客户端更新分散可能使少数类信号更难被鲁棒聚合保留，从而需要在三者联合的框架下重新审视。

Method: 提出"几何不可区分性"（geometric indistinguishability）作为概念视角，用于分析隐私诱导的更新分散如何影响鲁棒聚合对少数类信号的保留。以UNSW-NB15数据集为案例，将DP-SGD与坐标中位数（coordinate-wise median）聚合相结合，在标签翻转和模型投毒攻击场景下评估各攻击类别的威胁覆盖情况。

Result: 实验提供了初步证据表明：隐私噪声和鲁棒聚合的联合使用会不成比例地降低罕见攻击类别的检测性能（相对多数类）；强隐私条件下观察到的部分性能崩溃源于训练失校准；超罕见类别在epsilon相关调优后仍存在残余性能底限。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明隐私、鲁棒性和罕见攻击覆盖三者不应被视为独立可组合的性质，而应在联合框架下进行研究。提出了聚合感知建模（aggregation-aware modeling）和样本感知评估（sample-aware evaluation）作为构建可信联邦NIDS的有前景方向。

Abstract: Federated learning enables privacy-conscious collaboration for network intrusion detection without centralizing sensitive traffic data, yet its deployment in operational environments must simultaneously satisfy three competing requirements: formal differential privacy guaranties, tolerance to Byzantine-adversarial participants, and reliable detection coverage across severely imbalanced attack categories. Existing literature treats these properties as independently composable, an assumption that this paper challenges both theoretically and empirically. In this paper, we study how these requirements interact in class-imbalanced federated NIDS and introduce geometric indistinguishability as a conceptual lens for a regime in which privacy-induced dispersion in client updates can make minority-class signals harder for robust aggregation to preserve. Using UNSW-NB15 as a case study, we evaluate DP-SGD combined with coordinate-wise median under label-flip and model-poisoning attacks, with threat coverage assessed across attack categories. Our results provide initial evidence that the joint use of privacy noise and robust aggregation can disproportionately degrade detection of rare attacks relative to majority classes. We also show that part of the observed collapse under strong privacy can arise from training miscalibration, while a residual performance floor may remain for ultra-rare categories even after epsilon-dependent tuning. These findings motivate studying privacy, robustness, and rare-attack coverage jointly rather than as independently composable properties, and suggest that aggregation-aware modeling and sample-aware evaluation are promising directions for trustworthy federated NIDS.

</details>


### [196] [The Native-Signature Boundary in Post-Quantum Distributed Authorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03547)
*Dariia Porechna*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文探讨后量子签名迁移中分布式授权的架构问题，提出三个关键属性（原生签名兼容性、单方签名抵抗性、阈值层敏捷性）并系统分类了各类阈值签名方案，指出没有任何现成设计能同时满足三者，揭示了分布式授权密码学敏捷性的架构张力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后量子签名迁移在多方分布式授权场景下存在系统层面的独特难题。原生阈值签名将算法与密钥生成、份额状态、预处理、交互、组合、刷新和恢复等环节强耦合；而在原生签名关系外评估阈值策略的架构虽可降低耦合，但其授权证据无法被未修改的原生验证器接受，除非借助可信完整密钥签名者进行转换。这一矛盾需要被系统化梳理和组织。

Method: 作者提出了三个核心属性来组织设计边界：(1) 原生签名兼容性（native-signature compatibility）、(2) 单方签名抵抗性（unilateral-signing resistance）、(3) 阈值层敏捷性（threshold-layer agility）。基于此框架，对专业阈值签名、通用MPC签名、分布式哈希树签名、可编程多重签名与双门授权、阈值授权HSM签名五类方案进行了分类分析，并定义了迁移影响面以识别随签名算法变化的组件。

Result: 在所调研的各类方案族中，没有任何一种设计能同时提供原生签名输出、单方签名抵抗性以及阈值层敏捷性这三大属性。这一结果表明该限制是架构层面的固有权衡而非纯粹的技术可实现性问题。

Conclusion: 该文揭示了一个重要的架构洞见：仅靠可替换（replaceable）API并不足以实现分布式授权的密码学敏捷性。三个核心属性之间存在固有权衡，这一架构张力澄清了后量子迁移中为何简单的接口抽象无法解决问题，为未来系统设计提供了清晰的分析框架和方向指引。

Abstract: Post-quantum signature migration poses a distinct systems problem when authorization is distributed among multiple parties. In native threshold signing, the signature algorithm may determine key generation, share state, preprocessing, interaction, combination, refresh, and recovery. Architectures that evaluate threshold policy outside the native signing relation can reduce this coupling, but their authorization evidence is not accepted by an unchanged native verifier unless a trusted complete-key signer translates approval into a native signature.
  This paper organizes that design boundary through three properties: native-signature compatibility, unilateral-signing resistance, and threshold-layer agility. We classify specialized threshold signatures, generic MPC signing, distributed hash-based constructions, programmable multisignature and dual-gate authorization, and threshold-authorized HSM signing. A migration impact surface identifies which components change with the signature algorithm. Across the surveyed families, no design simultaneously provides native output, unilateral-signing resistance, and threshold-layer agility. This is an architectural tension, not an impossibility claim, and it clarifies why a replaceable API alone does not make distributed authorization cryptographically agile.

</details>


### [197] [Security and Privacy in the Musical Metaverse: Threat Analysis and Design Implications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03659)
*Luca Turchet,Michał Kłosinski*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对音乐元宇宙（Musical Metaverse）生态系统进行了多层威胁分析，识别了包括现场音乐内容、表达性交互数据、身份与会话元数据及知识产权在内的关键资产，从网络、应用、数据/AI、设备、知识产权和社会六个层面分析了威胁。通过14位来自13个组织的利益相关者调查，发现神经生理数据泄露和实时流中断被认为是最关键风险。研究评估了现有安全协议在超低延迟约束下的适用性，指出TLS/TCP等传统方法不适用于实时音乐交互，而SRTP、DTLS等轻量级流导向机制更适合。最终提出了面向延迟感知安全、交互路径差异化、数据最小化和边缘中心处理的MM系统设计指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐元宇宙引入了具有超低延迟约束、连续多模态数据流和异构设备的沉浸式实时协作音乐交互环境，其安全与隐私格局与传统的扩展现实或多媒体系统有显著差异，但缺乏针对该系统特性的系统性安全分析。

Method: 采用多层威胁分析框架，在六个层次上系统分析威胁；开展涉及14名来自13个组织参与者的利益相关者驱动的调查；评估现有安全协议在严格延迟约束下的适用性；基于研究结果推导设计指南。

Result: 揭示了表达性与神经生理数据带来的推断、重识别和隐私侵犯风险；确认神经生理数据泄露和实时流中断为最严重风险，其次是知识产权侵权和化身冒用；证明TLS over TCP等常规安全方法不兼容实时音乐交互，SRTP和DTLS等能更好地平衡安全与性能。

Conclusion: 音乐元宇宙需要安全设计与系统架构同步推进（security-by-design），通过延迟感知安全机制、交互路径差异化、数据最小化和边缘中心处理等设计原则，在不牺牲实时性能的前提下实现信任与合规。

Abstract: The Musical Metaverse (MM) introduces immersive, real-time environments for collaborative musical interaction, characterized by ultra-low-latency constraints, continuous multimodal data streams, and heterogeneous devices. These properties create a distinctive security and privacy landscape that differs significantly from conventional XR or multimedia systems. This paper presents a multi-layer threat analysis of MM ecosystems, identifying key assets including live musical content, expressive interaction data, identity and session metadata, and intellectual property. Threats are analyzed across network, application, data/AI, device, intellectual property rights, and social layers, with particular attention to risks arising from expressive and neurophysiological data, which enable inference, re-identification, and potential privacy violations. We describe a stakeholder-driven survey involving 14 participants from 13 organizations, revealing that neurophysiological data leakage and real-time stream disruption are perceived as the most critical risks, followed by intellectual property infringement and avatar impersonation. We further evaluate the suitability of existing security protocols under strict latency constraints, showing that conventional approaches such as TLS over TCP are often incompatible with real-time musical interaction, while lightweight, stream-oriented mechanisms (e.g., SRTP, DTLS) provide a more suitable balance between security and performance. Based on these findings, we derive a set of design guidelines for MM systems, emphasizing latency-aware security, differentiation of interaction paths, data minimization, and edge-centric processing. The results support a security-by-design approach that enables trust and compliance without compromising real-time performance.

</details>


### [198] [AlcaTRAz - Anchored Tree-Rule Defense Against Jailbreaks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03693)
*Jakub Reš,Petr Kaška,Martin Perešíni,Martin Ukrop,Kamil Malinka*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出AlcaTRAz，一种基于规则树的提示级防御方法，仅作用于输入文本，无需访问或修改目标模型权重。该方法自动学习可迁移的字符级扰动规则，破坏越狱攻击利用的结构规律，同时尽量保持良性查询下的模型效用。在33个开源模型、22种越狱攻击类型的评估中，AlcaTRAz在73.4%的模型-攻击组合中取得最佳综合安全与功能性得分，将严重恶意响应从模态值10降至接近拒绝的2，同时良性得分仅损失0.27分。该方法显著降低但未完全消除越狱成功率，定位为纵深防御的一层而非独立保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型易受通过精心构造提示词绕过安全对齐的越狱攻击。现有防御大多需要访问模型权重或内部状态，难以应用于黑盒部署场景。因此需要一种仅基于输入文本、无需修改目标模型的轻量级防御方法。

Method: AlcaTRAz采用基于规则树的提示级防御，自动学习可迁移的转换规则，在所选位置插入受控的字符级扰动，从而破坏越狱攻击所利用的结构规律性，同时尽量保持对良性查询的能力。该方法在推理时仅处理输入文本，不依赖目标模型内部信息。

Result: 在33个开源模型、22种越狱攻击类型的评估中，对比Llama Guard、RA-LLM和Goal Prioritization三个基线，AlcaTRAz在73.4%的模型-攻击组合中取得最佳综合安全与功能性得分。防御前恶意响应的模态得分为10（最大严重度），防御后降为2（接近拒绝），良性查询平均得分从8.62小幅降至8.35（0-10尺度）。但越狱成功率未完全消除，仍存在高严重度尾部。

Conclusion: AlcaTRAz是一种有效的、仅依赖输入文本的越狱防御方法，在安全性和功能性之间取得了良好平衡，显著降低越狱成功率且对良性查询影响有限。但由于存在残余的高严重度风险且未考虑自适应攻击者，该方法应作为纵深防御体系中的一层防御而非独立的安全保证。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that bypass safety alignment through carefully crafted prompts. Many existing defenses require access to model weights or internals, making them difficult to apply to black-box deployments. We propose AlcaTRAz (Anchored Tree-Rule defense Against jailbreaks), a prompt-level defense based on rule trees that operates exclusively on the input text and requires no modification or retraining of the target model. The method automatically learns a transferable transformation rule that inserts controlled character-level perturbations at selected positions, thereby disrupting structural regularities exploited by jailbreak attacks while largely preserving the model's utility on benign queries. We evaluate the proposed method across 33 open-weight models, 22 jailbreak attack types, and a benchmark of short, single-turn benign questions, comparing against three representative prompt-level baselines (Llama Guard, RA-LLM, Goal Prioritization). Among the compared defenses, AlcaTRAz achieves the best composite security and functionality score in 73.4 % of model-attack combinations and shifts the aggregate score from a modal value of 10 (maximal-severity response to the malicious request) in the undefended setting to a modal value of 2 (near-refusal) after defense, while keeping the mean benign score within 0.27 points of the undefended baseline (8.35 vs. 8.62 on a 0-10 scale). AlcaTRAz substantially reduces but does not eliminate jailbreak success: a high-severity tail remains, and we do not consider adaptive attackers, so we position it as one layer within a defense-in-depth strategy rather than a standalone guarantee.

</details>


### [199] [Rent-a-RAG: Embedding-Space Watermarks for Auditing Third-Party RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03749)
*Alexandr Goultiaev Tolstokorov,Kyriakos Mouratidis,Javad Dogani,Nikolaos Laoutaris*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: DirBucket 是一个提供商侧语义水印和黑盒审计框架，用于检测多提供商 RAG 系统中未经授权的文档级复用。它通过对文档进行保持语义的释义并将嵌入向量偏向提供商专属的"桶"秘密方向来实现水印，使得即使在生成器对答案进行改写的情况下也能从黑盒答案中检测到文档复用。实验表明，该方法是唯一能够在混合提供商、黑盒访问基准上始终保持强目标检测且无误触发的方案，并且水印能抵御对抗性后处理清洗，检测可跨基准迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第三方 RAG 市场引发新的审计问题：数据提供商将语料授权给 RAG 运营商后，无法监控其文档是否被未经补偿地复用。这类似于一种基于版权的"侧信道"审计需求。审计困难在于：运营商不合作（非黑盒可观测性受限）、生成器会对答案进行释义改写、以及单个回答可能综合多个提供商的证据，这使得归属检测极具挑战。

Method: DirBucket 采用提供商侧语义水印方法：(1) 通过保持语义的释义改写文档，使其嵌入向量向"提供商-桶"专属的秘密方向偏移；(2) 水印嵌入在语义空间而非文本表面，因此对释义具有鲁棒性；(3) 检测完全在黑盒层面进行，即仅通过观测生成的回答即可判断特定提供商的文档是否被复用，无需访问 RAG 内部结构。

Result: 在反映混合提供商复用和黑盒访问的挑战性基准上，DirBucket 是唯一能持续实现强目标检测且无误触发的方法，在主基准的每次审计中均能在 23 条审计答案内检测到不合规行为。水印能抵御对抗性答案清洗攻击，且没有一种逃避策略能在保持用户感知答案质量的同时同时击败检测。检测可直接迁移到由真实临床、网络威胁情报和法律提供商语料构建的第二个基准上。

Conclusion: 嵌入空间水印可以使第三方 RAG 中的文档复用实现统计学上的可审计性。该工作为 RAG 生态中的版权合规和补偿审计提供了可行的技术路径，证明在不牺牲检索效用的前提下完成黑盒级别的文档复用检测是可行的。

Abstract: Third-party retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) marketplaces create a new auditing problem: data providers may license corpora to a RAG operator, yet later have no visibility into whether their documents are being reused without compensation. Auditing this misuse is difficult because the operator is non-cooperative, answers are paraphrased by the generator, and one response may combine evidence from many providers. We propose DirBucket, a provider-side semantic watermarking and black-box auditing framework for document-level reuse in multi-provider RAG. DirBucket watermarks documents by meaning-preserving paraphrases whose embeddings are biased toward provider-bucket secret directions, enabling detection from black-box answers while preserving retrieval utility. On a challenging benchmark that reflects mixed-provider reuse under black-box access, DirBucket is the only method that consistently achieves strong target detection with no non-target activation, detecting non-compliance in every audit within 23 audited answers on our primary benchmark. The watermark survives adversarial post-answer laundering, and none of the evaluated evasion strategies simultaneously defeats detection while preserving user-perceived answer quality. Detection transfers unchanged to a second benchmark built from real clinical, cyber-threat-intelligence, and legal provider corpora. These results suggest that embedding-space watermarking can make document reuse in third-party RAG statistically auditable.

</details>


### [200] [Beyond the Trust Boundary: A Critical Reassessment of the FIDO2 Threat Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03789)
*Aditya Mitra,Kolluru Sai Abhiram,Sibi Chakkaravarthy Sethuraman,Anitha S*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文批判性地重新评估了FIDO2/WebAuthn的威胁模型，识别了八个跨层攻击向量，证明FIDO2的安全假设在真实部署环境下不成立。研究表明FIDO2的主要弱点不在密码学层，而在于周围的可信环境（浏览器、操作系统、硬件等）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FIDO2/WebAuthn被广泛部署为抗钓鱼认证方案，其安全性通常被认为在密码学实现正确的前提下由设计保证。然而作者指出，这种假设在真实部署条件下过于乐观，现有威胁模型忽视了除密码学层以外的攻击面。

Method: 作者将威胁模型扩展到密码学层之外，系统性地考察了FIDO2栈中的八个攻击向量：恶意浏览器扩展、平台处理器恶意软件、被动嗅探、虚拟设备驱动程序、CTAP2特定恶意软件、USB/硬件植入、恶意USB集线器/坞站/延长器以及NFC中继攻击。同时分析了AAGUID和时间信息如何实现用户画像，以及多层攻击链如何绕过安全保证，并检查了对FIDO2元数据服务（MDS3）的攻击。

Result: 分析显示FIDO2依赖的环境假设在实践中可能不成立：浏览器、操作系统或硬件的妥协可以在密码学原语未被攻破的情况下破坏FIDO2安全；攻击链可以跨层组合以绕过预期安全保证；设备证明可通过针对MDS3的攻击被削弱。这些攻击按特权、技能和资源需求进行了分类。

Conclusion: 有效的FIDO2安全需要覆盖浏览器、操作系统、硬件、协议栈和元数据基础设施的分层缓解措施。密码学层的正确性不足以保证FIDO2的整体安全，周边可信环境的安全同等重要。

Abstract: FIDO2/WebAuthn has been widely deployed as a phishing-resistant authentication scheme. Because FIDO2 relies on public-key cryptography and hardware-backed authenticators, its security is often assumed to be guaranteed by design, provided that the cryptographic implementation is correct. In this work, we critically reassess the FIDO2 threat model and show that several commonly assumed security properties do not hold under realistic deployment conditions. We extend the threat model beyond the cryptographic layer to examine eight attack vectors across the FIDO2 stack: malicious browser extensions, platform-handler malware, passive sniffing, virtual device drivers, CTAP2-specific malware, USB/hardware implants, malicious USB hubs/docks/extenders, and NFC relay attacks. Our analysis shows that FIDO2 depends on environmental assumptions that may not hold in practice. We demonstrate how AAGUID and timing information can enable user profiling and targeted attacks, and how compromise of the browser, operating system, or hardware can undermine FIDO2 security even when the underlying cryptographic primitives remain uncompromised. We further show that attack chains spanning multiple layers can bypass the intended security guarantees of FIDO2. These findings indicate that the primary weakness in a FIDO2 deployment is often not the cryptographic layer, but the surrounding trusted environment. We also examine how these attack vectors can undermine device attestation by targeting the FIDO Metadata Service (MDS3), which serves as a root of trust for authenticator metadata. Finally, we characterize the attacks according to privilege, skill, and resource requirements. We conclude that effective FIDO2 security requires layered mitigations covering the browser, operating system, hardware, protocol stack, and metadata infrastructure.

</details>


### [201] [Inferring Hidden User Models from the Behavior of Personalized LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03815)
*Haoyang Li,Yaxin Xiao,Qingqing Ye,Huadi Zheng,Haibo Hu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出UMPeek，一种黑盒攻击方法，通过假设引导的自适应探测来推断个性化LLM代理中隐藏的用户模型（用户信息的压缩/结构化表示），证明即使源文本和后端状态不可访问，攻击者仍可从模型个性化行为中恢复用户私密信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有观点认为，将个人信息转换为用户模型而非保留原始文本可以增强隐私保护，因为直接的记忆提取攻击将失去目标文本。然而作者指出这种假设存在缺陷：用户模型塑造的个性化选择本身构成了新的攻击面，攻击者可以在源代码和后端状态不可访问的情况下，仅通过可观察行为恢复这些私密信息。

Method: UMPeek采用基于假设引导的自适应探测策略：(1) 从请求中未被回答的开放选项中形成假设；(2) 在普通的后续任务之间切换以收集行为证据；(3) 仅保留被观察行为支持且未被反驳的推断结论。该方法在多种个性化任务和用户模型后端上进行了广泛基准评估。

Result: 在基准测试和真实系统比较中，UMPeek均优于现有攻击方法，并且即使面对响应级防御措施仍能持续恢复用户信息。真实系统验证使用了确认被系统保留的信息。

Conclusion: 即使记录和后端状态不可访问，只要保留的信息塑造了可见行为，就不存在语义隐私保证。现有的"去文本即隐私"假设需要被重新审视，需要设计针对自适应探测的更强防御策略。

Abstract: Recent personalized LLM agents increasingly transform information retained in memory into compressed or structured representations, which we call user models, to guide later decisions. When source wording is removed from the state reachable through the ordinary interface, these models are commonly treated as more privacy-preserving because direct memory-extraction attacks lose the text they target. Yet we argue that user models expose a new attack surface because an attacker can still recover the private information from the personalized choices they shape, even when source records and backend state remain inaccessible. We therefore introduce UMPeek, a black-box attack based on hypothesis-guided adaptive probing to infer such hidden user model. It forms hypotheses from choices left open by a request, switches among ordinary follow-up tasks, and retains only claims supported and not contradicted by visible behavior. We conduct an extensive benchmark evaluation across diverse personalization tasks and user-model backends against existing attacks. We further validate UMPeek in real-world systems using information confirmed to be retained, and we evaluate defenses against its adaptive probing. Overall, UMPeek outperforms existing attacks in both benchmark and real-world comparisons and continues to recover user information under response-level defenses, showing that keeping records and backend state inaccessible does not guarantee semantic privacy when retained information shapes visible behavior.

</details>


### [202] [Flip, Don't Shuffle: Watermarking LLMs at the Speed of Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03844)
*Simone Ceppi,Ignacio Sanchez*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为Stateless Bernoulli Watermarking (SBW)的大语言模型统计水印方法，通过独立逐token Bernoulli试验确定绿名单成员资格，将成员复杂度降至O(1)，支持全词表自盐渍水印和分布式推理兼容，额外开销小于1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM水印方法（如KGW和SynthID）在绿名单成员判定上依赖词表置换或多层锦标赛结构，复杂度较高；自盐渍（self-salt）场景下开销巨大，且难以兼容分布式推理。作者旨在设计一种无状态、低复杂度但保持同等检测保证的水印架构。

Method: SBW用独立的逐token Bernoulli试验替代KGW的词表置换和SynthID的多层锦标赛来确定绿名单成员。每个token仅需一次与基于计数器的随机数生成器的比较，成员资格复杂度为O(1)，可在单内核下执行且无中间分配。论文从理论上证明了该方法与固定大小绿名单具有相同的检测保证（零假设下z-score服从N(0,1)）。此外，作者识别出哈希函数设计是水印质量的一个新维度，提出使用GPU原生的Jenkins哈希改善零假设校准（提升1.8倍）并生成更多样化的文本。

Result: 在全词表自盐渍水印场景下，SBW比KGW快6000倍以上，比SynthID快2倍。端到端生成基准测试中，SBW在所有批大小下额外开销均小于1%。Jenkins哈希将零假设校准提升1.8倍并产生更多样化的文本。在两种播种方案和八种(γ,δ)配置下，ROC-AUC差异均低于0.01，确认了与现有方法的统计等价性。

Conclusion: SBW通过无状态Bernoulli试验设计，在保持与固定绿名单方法相同检测保证的前提下，实现了O(1)成员复杂度、全词表自盐渍水印和分布式推理兼容等现有方法无法同时具备的能力，同时将哈希函数设计确立为水印质量优化的新研究轴。

Abstract: We introduce Stateless Bernoulli Watermarking (SBW), a new statistical watermark for Large Language Models that determines green list membership through independent per-token Bernoulli trials. Unlike KGW's vocabulary permutation or SynthID's multi-layer tournament, SBW requires only a single comparison per token against a counter-based random number generator, reducing membership complexity to $O(1)$ and enabling single-kernel execution with zero intermediate allocations. We prove that this formulation preserves the same detection guarantees as fixed-size green lists: the z-score test remains $\mathcal{N}(0,1)$ under the null. The stateless architecture enables capabilities unavailable to existing methods: full-vocabulary self-salt watermarking (over 6000$\times$ faster than KGW's self-salt and 2$\times$ faster than SynthID despite biasing the entire vocabulary with candidate-dependent seeding) and architectural compatibility with distributed inference. In end-to-end generation benchmarks, SBW adds less than 1\% overhead at all batch sizes. We additionally identify hash function design as a previously unexplored axis for watermark quality, showing that a GPU-native Jenkins hash improves null calibration by 1.8$\times$ while producing more diverse text. Experiments across two seeding schemes and eight $(γ, δ)$ configurations confirm statistical equivalence with ROC-AUC differences below 0.01.

</details>


### [203] [NACRE: Rethinking Confidential Containers through Native Architectural Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03849)
*Linke Song,Wenhao Wang,Weijie Liu,Rui Hou*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: NACRE是一个RISC-V软硬件协同设计系统，通过将主机的资源管理权限与访问/提交受保护状态的权限分离，实现原生机密容器。它利用硬件识别的容器身份将受保护的陷阱重定向到隔离的S模式代理，而M模式监视器负责提交安全敏感的身份、映射和页面转换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Linux容器通过共享宿主内核实现高密度和快速生命周期操作，但这也让被攻陷的主机能检查或修改容器状态。现有的机密计算系统保护的是enclave地址空间或整个客户操作系统，即便最近的容器粒度系统也引入了额外的保护上下文，没有将动态的主机管理的Linux进程组作为架构保护单元。

Method: NACRE提出将主机管理资源的权限与其访问或提交受保护状态的权限相分离的架构设计。硬件识别的容器身份将受保护陷阱重定向到隔离的S模式代理；M模式监视器提交安全敏感的身份、映射和页面转换。代理在不改变satp的情况下将服务委托给主机Linux；不访问私有字节也不修改受保护状态的服务可避免M模式。原型通过扩展QEMU、OpenSBI、Linux、可信代理和runc实现，涵盖launch、fault、fork/COW、user-access和teardown等路径。

Result: 原型实现了单容器私有内存基板。在五个lmbench系统调用和管道指标中，三轮运行均值保持在runc原始基线的3.5%以内；在nginx八个对象大小均值等权重的聚合吞吐量上，性能仅降低1.9%。

Conclusion: NACRE通过软硬件协同设计在RISC-V架构上实现了原生机密容器，在提供容器粒度保护的同时保持了与基准接近的性能开销，验证了分离资源管理与状态访问权限这一关键思路的可行性和有效性。

Abstract: Linux containers achieve high density and fast lifecycle operations by sharing the host kernel, but this design also lets a compromised host inspect or modify container state. Existing
  confidential-computing systems protect an enclave address space or an entire guest operating system, while recent container-granularity systems still add a separate protection context.
  These abstractions do not make a dynamic group of host-managed Linux processes the architectural protection unit.
  This paper presents NACRE, a RISC-V hardware-software co-design for native confidential containers. Its key insight is to separate the host's authority to manage resources from its
  authority to access or commit protected state. Hardware-recognized container identities direct protected traps to an isolated S-mode agent, while an M-mode monitor commits security-
  sensitive identity, mapping, and page transitions. The agent delegates services to host Linux without changing satp; services that neither access private bytes nor modify protected
  state also avoid M-mode. We prototype NACRE by extending QEMU, OpenSBI, Linux, a trusted agent, and runc. The prototype implements the single-container private-memory substrate and
  covered launch, fault, fork/COW, user-access, and teardown paths. Across five lmbench syscall and pipe metrics, the three-run means remain within 3.5% of the runc-origin baseline. With
  the eight nginx object-size means weighted equally, aggregate throughput is 1.9% lower.

</details>


### [204] [A Blind Trust, the Bloody Thrust: When Attacker-Controlled Hook Updates Steer AI Agent Harnesses towards Malicious Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03884)
*Pengxun Li,Litian Zhang,Jianwei Hou,Shujiang Wu,Song Li,Zifeng Kang,Xi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Modern AI agent harnesses expose lifecycle hooks that bind shell commands to runtime events such as session start, tool calls, and file edits. These commands run with host privileges yet ship as lifecycle-hook configuration and may fire at times the LLM never observes. We identify the lifecycle-hook update path, which harnesses trust blindly, as a new attack surface. Under a supply-chain threat model in which an attacker controls only plugin metadata and lifecycle-hook configuration, a benign versioned plugin can be trojanized by an update that silently binds attacker-chosen commands to benign events, yielding malicious host-side behavior such as privilege escalation. We propose HookPry, an open-source and fully automated attack framework that systematically exploits this vulnerability across heterogeneous AI agent harnesses. HookPry realizes ten attack objectives; across 25 combinations of harnesses and backends in 1,000 end-to-end runs, it compromises all seven evaluated harnesses, with per-harness success rates reaching 92.5%. Representative defenses remain insufficient: Microsoft Defender has 0% recall, and the union of three static defenses misses 47.5% of malicious artifacts.

</details>


### [205] [Practice Makes (Im)Perfect: A Look Back at Benchmarking Practices for Microarchitectural Side-Channel Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03893)
*Iliana Fayolle,Antoine Geimer,Daniel De Almeida Braga,Clémentine Maurice*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文系统调研了2014至2024年间发表于顶级安全与架构会议上的83篇微架构侧信道攻击论文，识别并定义了19种常见基准评测缺陷（平均每篇论文存在5.5种），指出当前基准评测实践在完整性、相关性、健全性和可复现性方面存在严重问题，并提出了评估新攻击所需的关键属性建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微架构侧信道攻击研究快速增长，但现有基准评测实践存在严重问题：早期论文依赖间接代理指标（如隐蔽信道带宽或对朴素AES/RSA实现的密钥恢复），形成事实标准并被后续工作盲目复制。由于微架构攻击对实验条件极其敏感，微小的系统变化即可显著改变结果，不充分的评测实践破坏了可复现性，使对比结果的可信度存疑，即使顶级会议也未能识别此类问题。

Method: 作者对2014年至2024年间发表在顶级安全与架构会议上的83篇攻击论文进行了系统性调研，从语料中识别并定义了19种影响评测完整性、相关性、健全性和可复现性的常见基准缺陷（如不公平或缺失的对比、缺少代码或材料、未能评估关键攻击属性等），并统计分析了缺陷的分布情况、随时间的变化趋势以及安全与架构会议之间的实践差异。

Result: 调研发现每篇论文平均存在5.5种基准评测缺陷，说明即使在高度选择性的顶级会议中，评测问题也极为普遍。作者基于发现提出了评估新型攻击时应关注的关键属性，并揭示了评测实践随时间的变化趋势以及安全会议与架构会议之间的不同实践方式。

Conclusion: 当前微架构侧信道攻击领域的基准评测实践严重不足，亟需建立更严格、更具相关性、更可复现的评测标准，以提升该领域研究的整体质量与可信度。

Abstract: Microarchitectural side-channel research has grown at an exceptional pace in recent years, increasing the need for rigorous and meaningful benchmarking. Early attack papers typically relied on indirect proxies, such as covert-channel bandwidth or key-recovery on naive AES and RSA implementations, setting de facto standards that many subsequent works continued to replicate, sometimes by directly comparing against raw numbers from prior work. While these practices offer convenient points of comparison, current benchmarks may not be the most relevant to assess specific properties of new primitives. Even more problematic, microarchitectural attacks are notoriously sensitive to experimental conditions: minimal changes in the target system can significantly alter outcomes and performance. As a result, inadequate evaluation practices undermine reproducibility and cast doubt on the relevance of comparisons, even in top-tier venues where such issues should be identified. This paper tackles the core problem of proper benchmarking for microarchitectural side-channel attacks and examines its broader impact on research quality in the field. We survey 83 attack papers published in top-ranked security and architecture conferences from 2014 to 2024. From this corpus, we identify and define 19 recurrent benchmarking flaws that affect evaluation completeness, relevance, soundness, and reproducibility. These flaws include unfair or absent comparisons, missing code or materials, and the failure to evaluate the key attack properties. On average, each paper exhibits 5.5 such flaws, highlighting how widespread the issue is, even in highly selective venues. Based on our findings, we identify and suggest key properties that are relevant to properly evaluate new attacks. We also highlight trends over time and different practices between security and architecture conferences.

</details>


### [206] [A Black Box for Agentic Processes: Blockchain-Anchored Evidence for AI Agent Communication, Human Oversight, and GRC Audits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04017)
*Arslan Brömme*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向自主AI代理流程的、基于区块链锚定密码学承诺的黑盒审计架构，在不将敏感内容上链的前提下，为代理通信、人工审批、工具调用和过程工件建立可验证的取证基础，以支持治理、风险与合规（GRC）需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主AI代理之间日益频繁的通信、工具调用、中间结果交换及人工审批流程产生了新的可审计性问题——组织需要重建"发生了什么、何时发生、涉及哪个代理或人类、适用何种控制策略、记录事后是否被篡改"，而2026年OpenAI/Hugging Face事件进一步凸显了这一需求的紧迫性。

Method: 提出一种产品与供应商中立的黑盒架构，通过将选择的代理通信、人工参与审批、工具调用和过程工件生成区块链锚定的密码学承诺，同时避免将敏感内容上链。定义了区分时间锚定与工件完整性与事件排序、捕获真实性、授权锚定和因果可追溯性的证据模型，后者需要额外的架构控制支持。

Result: 讨论了该架构在治理、风险与合规（GRC）中的实际应用，包括合规测试、基于风险的证据选择、证据流监控、事件重建以及面向欧盟AI法案、NIS2和网络弹性法案（CRA）的监管报告就绪性。作为position论文，未提供实证性能或安全评估。

Conclusion: 该方法并不阻止代理不当行为或证明语义真实性，而是强化关键过程轨迹后续验证的证据基础，为代理工作流的后验审计和监管合规提供更可靠的技术支撑。

Abstract: Autonomous AI agents increasingly communicate with other agents, invoke tools, exchange intermediate results, and request human approvals. These workflows create a new auditability problem: organizations must reconstruct what happened, when it happened, which agent or human was involved, which control or policy applied, and whether records were modified afterwards. Motivated by the 2026 OpenAI/Hugging Face incident, this position and architecture paper proposes a product- and vendor-neutral black-box architecture for agentic processes. The architecture creates blockchain-anchored cryptographic commitments for selected agent communications, human-in-the-loop approvals, tool calls, and process artifacts without placing sensitive content on-chain. We define an evidence model that distinguishes temporal anchoring and artifact integrity from event ordering, capture authenticity, authorized anchoring, and causal traceability. The latter properties require additional architectural controls. We then discuss practical use for Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), including compliance testing, risk-based evidence selection, monitoring evidence streams, incident reconstruction, and regulatory reporting readiness under the EU AI Act, NIS2, and the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA). This position and architecture paper does not present an empirical performance or security evaluation. The approach does not prevent agent misbehavior or prove semantic truth. Rather, it strengthens the evidentiary basis for later verification of critical process traces.

</details>


### [207] [PatchBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Vulnerability Patching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04075)
*Chihao Shen,Jiacheng Li,Aastha Mahajan,Jeffery Siyuan Tian,Yonghwi Kwon,Yizheng Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出PatchBench基准，用于评估AI智能体在C/C++漏洞修复任务中的真实能力。研究发现现有评估存在两个问题：智能体会记忆历史开发者补丁（平均25%的补丁与历史补丁高度相似），以及通过修补崩溃栈而非修复根本原因来表面化通过验证。PatchBench通过选择根本修复位于崩溃栈之外的真实漏洞、使用漏洞迁移和代码突变将其移植到新仓库上下文，并开发了更全面的补丁验证方法，揭示了11个SOTA智能体（包括AIxCC前三名）中纯PoC验证平均高估1.83倍解决率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI漏洞修复评估仅通过PoC测试来验证补丁是否有效，存在两个关键有效性威胁：（1）智能体可能重现记忆的历史开发者补丁，而非真正修复漏洞；（2）智能体可能生成仅抑制崩溃的表面修复。这两个问题导致对智能体实际能力的评估失真。

Method: (1) 提出补丁相似度度量来检测记忆化补丁；分析智能体对基准结构的利用行为。(2) 构建PatchBench：选取根本修复位于崩溃栈之外的漏洞，通过漏洞移植和代码突变将历史漏洞迁移到新的仓库上下文，降低表面修复和补丁记忆的风险。(3) 开发新的补丁验证方法，综合评估补丁的安全正确性和语义正确性。

Result: 平均25%的智能体补丁与历史开发者补丁高度相似，证实补丁记忆化是真实威胁。在11个SOTA智能体（包括AIxCC前三名）上的评估显示，纯PoC验证平均将漏洞修复任务的解决率高估1.83倍，暴露了当前智能体的关键局限性。

Conclusion: 当前基于PoC的评估方法严重高估了AI智能体的漏洞修复能力，AIxCC等顶级智能体在更严格的PatchBench基准上表现显著下降。补丁记忆化和表面修复是漏洞修复评估中必须解决的有效性威胁，未来需要更可靠的基准和验证方法来推动该领域的发展。

Abstract: AI agents have recently demonstrated strong performance in automated vulnerability patching. However, existing evaluations often validate a patch only by testing whether the provided Proof-of-Concept (PoC) input still triggers a crash. This leaves two key threats to validity: agents may reproduce memorized historical developer patches, or they may generate surface-level fixes that only suppress the reported crash.
  We study these concerns for C/C++ vulnerability patching. We introduce a patch similarity metric to detect memorized patches. On average, 25% of the agent patches exhibit substantial similarity to historical developer patches, indicating that patch memorization is a real threat to the validity of vulnerability patching evaluations. Meanwhile, agents also frequently exploit benchmark structures to pass patch validation by patching on the crash stack trace to suppress the crash, rather than localizing and fixing the root cause of the vulnerabilities.
  To handle these issues, we propose PatchBench, a new benchmark for evaluating AI agents on realistic vulnerability patching tasks. PatchBench selects vulnerabilities whose ground-truth fixes lie outside the crash stack and uses vulnerability transplant and code mutations to migrate historical vulnerabilities into new repository contexts, reducing the risks of surface-level fixes and patch memorization. We develop new patch validation methods that thoroughly evaluate both security and semantic correctness of agent patches. Across 11 state-of-the-art agents, including the top three AIxCC agents, the original PoC-only validation inflates the patching task solve rate of agents by 1.83$\times$ on average. Our results reveal key limitations of current patching agents and point to future research directions for more reliable vulnerability repair.

</details>


### [208] [A Non-Formulable Theorem: A Fundamental Limit of Finite Syntactic Systems and Its Consequences for Security and AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04086)
*Fabio F. G. Buono*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文证明了一个元定理：任何具有充分表达能力的有限句法系统，都存在至少一个该系统无法自主产生的定理。该结果适用于所有有限句法系统，包括安全机制、AI系统、形式验证器、法律系统、经济模型，甚至包括证明该定理本身的形式系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索有限句法系统的内在局限，证明任何充分表达力的有限系统都存在无法自主推导的定理，从而揭示系统固有的不完整性。

Method: 通过元定理（metatheorem）的构造性证明方式，对所有一致且充分表达力的有限句法系统建立存在性证明。

Result: 证明了在任意一致且足够表达力的有限句法系统中，至少存在一个该系统不能自主产生的定理。

Conclusion: 该结果具有普遍的元定理性质，不仅适用于数学形式系统，还适用于安全机制、AI系统、法律系统等广泛领域，并包含其自指性——即使该系统本身也受此限制。

Abstract: For every coherent and sufficiently expressive finite syntactic system S, we prove the existence of at least one theorem that S cannot produce autonomously. The result is a metatheorem: it proves the existence of a theorem, and applies to every finite syntactic system - security mechanisms, AI systems, formal verifiers, legal systems, economic models, and the formal system in which it is itself proved.

</details>


### [209] [SENTINEL-RL: Offloading Topological Reasoning from LLM Agents in the Security Operations Center](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04159)
*Uday Vallabhaneni,Cassie L. Cagwin,David J. Wild*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Sentinel-RL是一个智能体化SOC（安全运营中心）架构，通过将拓扑推理与语义推理解耦来解决大语言模型智能体在企业级规模下的两个核心限制：有限上下文窗口无法容纳多主机认证图，以及自由文本生成无法保证推荐动作与拓扑一致。系统采用异构图注意力编码器将认证子图压缩为固定维状态，PPO策略在受限动作空间中行动，LLM仅负责生成受评论器门控的分析叙事。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体虽被广泛提出作为自主SOC分析师，但在企业规模下存在两个根本性局限：一是有限上下文窗口无法承载包含数千主机的认证图；二是自由文本生成无法保证推荐的遏制动作与所操作拓扑结构的一致性。这些限制使LLM在真实企业安全运营中不可靠。

Method: 系统包含：(1) 异构图注意力编码器将实时认证子图汇总为固定维度状态；(2) PPO（近端策略优化）策略将该状态映射到受限的侦查动作集合；(3) LLM智能体循环被限制为仅消费策略推荐并生成分析师可读的叙述，且由评论器进行门控。在数据层使用两阶段的CREATE导入模式并在Neo4j中实现，并配备了滑窗告警引擎。

Result: (i) 两阶段CREATE导入模式在单节点32核上14.2分钟加载2400万边认证子图到Neo4j，比经典MERGE流水线快约24倍；(ii) 滑窗告警引擎在50次试验中可靠地在≤2.5秒内触发25事件/10秒阈值；(iii) PPO在200次迭代收敛，平均每回合回报8.74±0.31，标记红队事件上保留精度0.91、召回0.87；(iv) 集成遏制环完成完整检测-调查-推荐-人工批准周期中位时间为6.3秒。

Conclusion: 作者贡献了可复用的工程模式（热节点死锁规避）、可移植的HPC部署模式（锚节点共置），并提供了涵盖误报经济学、可逆性保证、审计合规和人工审批边界的企业级就绪分析。整体验证了将强化学习策略与LLM解耦架构在真实企业SOC工作负载下的可行性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous SOC analysts, but two limitations make them unreliable at enterprise scale: a finite context window cannot hold a multi-thousand-host authentication graph, and free-form generation offers no guarantee that a recommended containment action is consistent with the topology it operates on. We present Sentinel-RL, an agentic-SOC architecture that decouples topological reasoning from semantic reasoning: a heterogeneous graph attention encoder summarizes the live authentication subgraph into a fixed-dimensional state, a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy maps this state to a constrained set of investigative actions, and an LLM agent loop is restricted to consuming the policy's recommendations and producing analyst-readable narratives gated by a critic. We instantiate the system on the LANL Comprehensive, Multi-Source Cyber-Security Events dataset and the Indiana University Quartz HPC cluster, reporting four results: (i) a two-phase CREATE ingestion pattern loads a 24M-edge authentication subgraph into Neo4j in 14.2 minutes on a single 32-core node, roughly 24x faster than the canonical MERGE-based pipeline; (ii) a sliding-window alert engine reliably trips a 25-event/10-second threshold in <=2.5 s across 50 trials; (iii) PPO training over 200 iterations converges to a mean episodic return of 8.74+/-0.31, with held-out precision of 0.91 and recall of 0.87 on labeled red-team events; and (iv) the integrated containment loop completes a full detect-investigate-recommend-human-approve cycle in a median of 6.3 s. We contribute a reusable engineering pattern (the hot-node deadlock workaround), a portable HPC deployment pattern (anchor-node co-location), and an enterprise-readiness analysis covering false-positive economics, reversibility guarantees, audit compliance, and the human-approval boundary.

</details>

### [210] [A Time-Encoded Analog Photonic Interposer for Energy-EfficientIntegration of Analog Vision Sensors and Analog Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03125)
*Subhradip Chakraborty,Zihan Yin,Xuming Chen,Chengwei Zhou,Gourav Datta,Akhilesh Jaiswal*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种时间编码的模拟光子中介层（time-encoded analog photonic interposer），用于在空间分隔的chiplet之间传输高保真模拟信号。与传统仅限数字数据的硅光子链路不同，该中介层通过模拟-时间转换器（ATC）将幅度转换为时间间隔，经波分复用光子链路传输，并在接收端重建信号，无需高精度ADC/DAC。链路内嵌6位时间域量化，每个处理单元仅需单波长且与位精度无关。在全模拟视觉流水线中（配合像素内计算传感器），相比8位数字电学基线，在VWW数据集上实现2.04倍的能量-延迟积（EDP）提升，且优势随链路长度扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统硅光子互连仅支持数字数据传输，而chiplet间模拟信号传输需要高精度数据转换器（ADC/DAC），消耗大量能量和面积。作者希望直接传输模拟信号，避免显式的数据转换管线，从而提升能效和延迟性能，特别是在长距离chiplet互连场景下保持模拟信息的高保真度。

Method: 提出时间编码模拟光子中介层：(1) 使用模拟-时间转换器（ATC）将模拟幅度编码为时间间隔；(2) 通过波分复用光子链路传输；(3) 在接收端无需高精度ADC/DAC即可重建信号，依赖内嵌的隐式6位时间域量化；(4) 每个处理元素仅使用单波长，且不随位精度增加波长数。系统与像素内计算（IPC）传感器结合，构建全模拟视觉流水线进行评估。

Result: 在全模拟视觉流水线中，相比8位数字电学基线，在560x560 Visual Wake Words数据集上实现2.04倍的能量-延迟积（EDP）改进，且优势随链路长度增加而扩大（即便与特定位数匹配的6位基线相比依然如此）。ResNet18和MobileNetV2在VWW上分别达到89.87%和86.15%的准确率，并在CIFAR-10和ModelNet40上泛化，与数字基线的差距在2%以内。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了硅光子互连可以超越数字传输范式，实现高保真的模拟信号长距离传输。这种时间编码方案避免了高精度数据转换器带来的开销，显著提升能耗-延迟乘积，为高性能chiplet互连和边缘AI推理等场景提供了有前景的新架构方向。

Abstract: This work introduces a time-encoded analog photonic interposer that enables long-distance, high-fidelity transport of analog signals between spatially separated chiplets. Unlike prior silicon-photonic links limited to digital data, the interposer preserves analog information by converting amplitudes into timing intervals using an analog-to-time converter (ATC), transmitting them over a wavelength-division-multiplexed photonic link, and reconstructing values at the receiver without an explicit high-precision ADC/DAC data-converter pipeline. The link instead embeds an implicit 6-bit time-domain quantization and uses a single wavelength per processing element independent of bit precision. Evaluated in a fully analog vision pipeline with an in-pixel computing (IPC) sensor, it achieves a 2.04x energy--delay product (EDP) improvement over an 8-bit digital electrical baseline on the 560x560 Visual Wake Words dataset, with the advantage widening with link length even against a precision-matched 6-bit baseline. The pipeline holds 89.87% and 86.15% accuracy on ResNet18 and MobileNetV2 for VWW and generalizes across CIFAR-10 and ModelNet40 within 2% of the digital baseline.

</details>


### [211] [A single-precision floating-point systolic Givens-QRD Triangular Solver for MVDR Beamforming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03137)
*Athi Ram R S,Alwin A,S. G. Sreejeesh,J. U. Kidav*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于FPGA的Givens旋转QR分解流水线，用于实现32阵元超声换能器阵列的MVDR自适应波束形成。在Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA上以100 MHz运行三个并行内核实例，达到31,123重量向量/秒的吞吐量和90.9%的并行效率。与24核Intel Xeon Gold 5220R处理器相比，FPGA在可编程逻辑功耗基础上实现了2.3倍的功耗归一化吞吐量优势，但处理器在原始吞吐量上仍有约15倍的领先。数值精度经验证与MATLAB float32参考输出吻合，RMSE为5.10×10^-7，100%通过率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MVDR自适应波束形成的权重计算是延迟敏感操作，对实时硬件实现构成重大挑战。需要探索FPGA等替代计算平台以在保持数值精度的同时实现高效能计算。

Method: 采用FPGA实现了脉动Givens旋转QR分解流水线，使用单精度浮点运算；在Zynq UltraScale+上以100 MHz部署三个并行内核实例；通过Field II囊肿幻影仿真进行数值精度验证。

Result: FPGA实现31,123权重向量/秒的吞吐量，90.9%并行效率；可编程逻辑功耗2.451W，总功耗5.286W；功耗归一化吞吐量分别达12,698和5,888权重向量/s/W；比24核Xeon Gold 5220R在功耗归一化吞吐量上高2.3倍（PL）和1.05倍（总片上）；但处理器原始吞吐量约为FPGA的15倍；数值精度RMSE为5.10×10^-7，100%通过率。

Conclusion: FPGA实现MVDR波束形成在功耗效率方面优于多核处理器，但在原始吞吐量方面仍有较大差距；数值精度达到接近理论有限精度水平且无系统性偏差，证明该方法在实时波束形成应用中的可行性。

Abstract: Computation of adaptive beamforming weights in Minimum Variance Distortionless Response (MVDR) processing is a latency-critical operation that poses significant challenges for real-time hardware implementation. This paper presents an FPGA implementation of a systolic Givens-rotation QR decomposition pipeline for MVDR beamforming on a simulated 32-element ultrasound transducer array, using single-precision floating-point arithmetic. The design is deployed on a Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA at 100 MHz with three parallel kernel instances operating concurrently, achieving a measured throughput of 31,123 weight vectors/s at 90.9% parallel efficiency relative to the measured single-instance rate. At an estimated 2.451 W of programmable-logic power, and 5.286 W including the processing system, this corresponds to 12,698 and 5,888 weight vectors/s/W, respectively. Under a matched three-way dispatch, a 24-core Intel Xeon Gold 5220R at 2.20 GHz achieves 465,699 weight vectors/s at a measured 83.08 W package power, corresponding to 5,606 weight vectors/s/W. The FPGA therefore attains 2.3x the power-normalised throughput of the processor on a programmable-logic basis and 1.05x on a total on-chip basis. In contrast, the processor retains a raw throughput advantage of approximately 15x at this operating point. Numerical precision is validated against MATLAB float32 reference outputs from a Field II cyst phantom simulation, achieving a 100% pass rate with a root mean square error of 5.10x10^-7, confirming near-theoretical finite-precision behaviour without systematic bias.

</details>


### [212] [LevelSyn: Physical-Aware Logic Synthesis via Level-Asynchronous Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03594)
*Jingyi Zhou,Zhengyuan Shi,Ziyang Zheng,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: LevelSyn是一个物理感知的逻辑综合框架，通过层级异步图神经网络（GNN）预测门级坐标，并结合线长驱动的优化引擎，在EPFL基准测试上相比SOTA方法实现了6.89%的功耗降低和27.48%的时序延迟改善，DRC违规减少99.59%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着集成电路进入纳米尺度，传统逻辑综合与物理设计之间的脱节（如依赖非物理的线负载模型WLM）导致PPA显著退化并延长设计收敛周期。现有的基于谱域的布局预测方法忽略了网表的层级逻辑深度和信号流向，造成空间估计保真度低。因此需要弥合逻辑综合与物理设计之间的鸿沟。

Method: LevelSyn框架包含两大核心组件：(1) 层级异步GNN用于从And-Inverter Graphs（AIGs）中学习结构性和方向性语义，预测高保真度的门级坐标；(2) 针对工业规模设计引入层级对齐的子图划分策略，消除内存瓶颈同时保留局部逻辑依赖；(3) 将空间预测结果无缝集成到基于Berkeley ABC框架开发的物理感知综合引擎中，实现线长驱动的优化。

Result: 在EPFL基准测试套件上，LevelSyn相比SOTA方法实现了平均6.89%的功耗降低和27.48%的时序延迟改善；经布局布线后验证，DRC违规减少了99.59%，有效加速了设计收敛。

Conclusion: LevelSyn通过将层级图表示学习与线长驱动综合引擎相结合，成功弥合了逻辑综合与物理设计之间的鸿沟，证明了物理感知的逻辑综合在降低功耗、改善时序和减少DRC违规方面具有显著优势，能够有效加速纳米尺度下的设计收敛过程。

Abstract: As integrated circuit technology scales into the nanometer regime, the traditional disconnect between logic synthesis and physical design has led to significant PPA (Power, Performance, and Area) degradation and prolonged design closure cycles. Traditional logic synthesis relies on non-physical Wire Load Models (WLMs), while recent spectral-based placement predictors often neglect the inherent hierarchical logic depth and signal flow of netlists, which leads to low-fidelity spatial estimations. To bridge this gap, we propose LevelSyn, a novel physical-aware logic synthesis framework that integrates hierarchical representation learning with a wirelength-driven optimization engine. At its core, LevelSyn leverages a level-asynchronous Graph Neural Network (GNN) to predict high-fidelity gate coordinates by capturing the structural and directional semantics of And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs). To handle industrial-scale designs, a level-aligned subgraph partitioning strategy is introduced to eliminate memory bottlenecks while preserving local logical dependencies. These spatial insights are seamlessly integrated into a newly developed physical-informed synthesis engine within the Berkeley ABC framework. Experimental results on the EPFL benchmark suite demonstrate that LevelSyn significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, achieving an average power reduction of 6.89\% and a timing delay improvement of 27.48\%. Furthermore, post-place-and-route validation shows a 99.59\% reduction in design rule check (DRC) violations, highlighting its effectiveness in accelerating design convergence.

</details>


### [213] [Confidence-Gated Admission for Hardware Prefetching: When the Gate Matters More Than the Predictor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04040)
*Youssef Majdane,Simone Jarno Casartelli,Enrico Lopedoto*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该研究将学习型缓存预取器与经典预取器进行公平对比，发现"预取门控（admission gate）"而非预测器本身是决定性能的关键因素。当控制该变量后，257参数的在线MLP与经典步长预取器无本质差异；门控机制本身能在SPEC CPU2017上削减35%预取并提升精度，但DRAM读取变化仅0.07%，表明代理指标不能预测端到端行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习型缓存预取器的评估通常与经典预取器比较时未控制"是否总是发起请求"这一变量，将"预测模型"与"准入策略"混为一谈，导致评估结果有偏。

Method: 作者解耦预测模型与准入策略，采用匹配对照组：对257参数在线MLP和经典步长预取器施加相同的准入门控；此外在原生ChampSim的SPEC CPU2017程序上验证门控的架构作用，并形式化证明门控关闭执行等价于无预取基线。

Result: 神经网络的性能优势消失：MLP与门控步长预取器在随机流量上不可区分，在大多数规则流上更慢；门控本身削减35%预取并将精度从11%提升至15%，但DRAM读取仅变化0.07%。

Conclusion: 门控机制比预测器本身更重要；更好的代理指标（如预取精度）并不必然带来更好的端到端（DRAM/性能）结果。

Abstract: Learned cache prefetchers are typically evaluated against classical predictors that always issue requests, confounding the prediction model with the admission policy. We disentangle these variables with matched controls: the same admission gate is applied to both a 257-parameter online MLP and a classical stride predictor. The neural advantage vanishes; the MLP is indistinguishable from gated stride on random traffic and slower on most regular streams. The gate itself is architecturally useful independent of the predictor: on twenty SPEC CPU2017 programs in native ChampSim, it removes 35% of prefetches and improves accuracy from 11% to 15%, but DRAM reads change by only 0.07% demonstrating that proxy metrics do not predict endpoint behavior. We prove gate-closed execution reproduces the no-prefetch baseline exactly. The gate matters more than the predictor, and better proxies do not imply better endpoints.

</details>

### [214] [The Illusion of Independent Quorums: Epistemic Fault Domains and Correlated Cognitive Failures in Agentic Quorums](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.02925)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出Epistemic Fault Domains（EFDs）概念和Structural Epistemic Cut κ_E，用于量化在授权联盟中共享上游依赖所导致的多票投票风险，并设计了Dependency-Aware Quorum Controller（DAQC）在运行时强制执行结构切分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多代理quorum用于授权高风险基础设施和政策变更，但不同审查者往往共享上游遥测、文档或工具后端。当上游输入失败时，多个投票会同时受单一损坏原因影响——即复制并不等于认知冗余。这一安全漏洞需要被量化并解决。

Method: 引入Epistemic Fault Domains (EFDs)和Structural Epistemic Cut κ_E，量化相对于显式Epistemic Fault Basis所需的最小根故障数量；在闭合因果核算、保守暴露和授权对齐条件下证明κ_E是语义妥协所需根数量的下界（κ_S）；证明任意大quorum可保持κ_E=1、识别共享祖先不会增加信用弹性、固定阈值下添加投票者不能增加切分；设计DAQC在运行时准入强制执行结构切分。

Result: 通过解析推导和模拟验证DAQC机制的有效性，并提供一个冻结的120任务外部基准套件用于后续评估。

Conclusion: 复制不保证认知冗余；通过明确建模和量化投票者间共享的认知依赖，可以在运行时强制保证quorum的结构性认知独立性，从而为高安全关键授权提供更可靠的保证。

Abstract: Multi-agent quorums are widely used to authorize high-stakes infrastructure and policy mutations, yet distinct reviewers often share upstream telemetry, documents, or tool backends. When upstream inputs fail, multiple votes collapse onto a single corrupted cause: replication does not imply epistemic redundancy. We introduce Epistemic Fault Domains (EFDs) and the Structural Epistemic Cut κ_E, which quantifies the minimum number of modeled root faults whose exposure covers an authorizing coalition relative to an explicit Epistemic Fault Basis. Under closed causal accounting, conservative exposure, and authorization alignment, κ_E lower-bounds the number of roots required for semantic compromise (κ_S). We prove that arbitrarily large quorums can retain κ_E=1, that recognizing shared ancestry never increases credited resilience, and that adding voters at a fixed threshold cannot increase the cut under compatible exposure extensions. Finally, we design the Dependency-Aware Quorum Controller (DAQC) to enforce structural cuts at runtime admission, evaluate its mechanics via analytical derivations and simulations, and provide a frozen 120-task external benchmark suite.

</details>


### [215] [Fully Fluctuating Sleepy Consensus from Minimal Assumptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03063)
*Javier Nieto,Yuval Efron,Joachim Neu,Ling Ren*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文设计了一个基于最小假设（仅需PKI和VRF）的睡眠共识协议，在外部对手模型下支持完全波动的参与度，并通过引入"分级唤醒"新原语，使节点对哪些节点处于唤醒状态形成一致的看法，同时将协议扩展到支持节点"去腐化"（从腐败状态恢复为诚实）的场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比特币的PoW协议具有极强的鲁棒性：矿工可随时暂停工作，腐败矿工只需回归最长链即可恢复诚实身份。类似的PoS协议（睡眠模型）却无法匹配这种鲁棒性——在纯PKI模型下，睡眠共识协议必须严格限制对手参与度的波动。Efron等人（2025）虽通过外部对手模型实现了完全波动的参与度，但依赖VDF这一强密码学原语（本质上类似PoW，假设对手不能比诚实节点更快地计算顺序工作）。因此需要一种从更弱假设出发、实现同等鲁棒性的方案。

Method: 本文的核心技术是"分级唤醒"（graded wakeness），一种允许节点对哪些其他节点处于唤醒状态形成一致看法的全新原语。在此基础之上，作者构建了仅依赖PKI和VRF（无需VDF或硬件假设）的睡眠共识协议，支持外部对手模型下完全波动的参与度，并在诚实多数条件下运行。此外还提出扩展方案以处理"去腐化"场景（腐败节点回归诚实），该扩展仅需对VRF输出的不可预测性增加一个轻微假设以保障活性。

Result: 作者成功实现了在外部对手模型下、诚实多数条件下、参与度完全波动的睡眠共识协议，且假设条件达到最小化（仅需PKI和VRF），消除了VDF和硬件假设的需求；并进一步将协议扩展至支持腐败节点回归诚实的"去腐化"场景。

Conclusion: 本文通过引入"分级唤醒"原语，显著收缩了睡眠共识协议所需的假设基础（从VDF降至PKI+VRF），在不牺牲鲁棒性的前提下更接近比特币PoW协议的简单性，为此类PoS共识协议的理论研究提供了更基础的构建模块。

Abstract: Bitcoin's proof-of-work (PoW)-based protocol is remarkable for how little it asks of its participants. Not only can miners take breaks from work whenever they please, but it is almost unique in offering a path of contrition: corrupt miners can reclaim honest status simply by resuming mining on the longest chain. The protocol only requires that honest miners hold the majority of computational power at any given time. Analogous proof-of-stake (PoS) protocols, usually formalized via the sleepy model of Pass and Shi (2017), have fallen short of matching this robustness. In fact, sleepy consensus protocols in the plain PKI model must heavily restrict fluctuations in adversarial participation over time. The recent work of Efron, Neu, and Pitassi (2025) enables fully fluctuating participation in the sleepy model by introducing the external adversary model. Their protocol, however, relies on verifiable delay functions (VDFs), a strong cryptographic primitive that somewhat resembles PoW, by assuming that the adversary cannot compute sequential work significantly faster than honest nodes.
  In this work, we design a sleepy consensus protocol for fully fluctuating participation with an external adversary under an honest majority, from minimal assumptions: a public key infrastructure (PKI) and a verifiable random function (VRF). In particular, we make no VDF or hardware assumptions. Our key technique is graded wakeness, a novel primitive that allows nodes to form consistent opinions on which other nodes are awake. We further extend our protocol to handle uncorruption, where corrupt nodes return to honesty. This extension requires only a mild additional assumption on the unpredictability of VRF outputs for liveness.

</details>


### [216] [Skywing: A Platform for Decentralized Mathematical Computing in Unreliable Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03145)
*Alyson Fox,Colin Ponce,Annika Mauro,Wayne Mitchell,Sarah Osborn,Tom Benson,Shayna Kapadia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Skywing是一个开源的去中心化数学计算平台，专为不可靠通信环境设计。它通过三个核心抽象（代理、处理器、迭代）支持异构设备上的异步去中心化计算，并提供发布-订阅通信、消息管理和算法组合能力。实验展示了在共识、优化和数值线性代数领域的多种算法的可行性与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘计算、自主系统和信息物理系统需要在不可靠通信网络连接的异构设备间进行数学计算。传统高性能计算和分布式数据处理框架依赖集中协调、可信通信和全局同步，难以适应去中心化、不可靠的环境，因此亟需一种适用于此类场景的平台。

Method: Skywing的编程模型包含三个抽象：代理（agents）代表去中心化计算的参与者，处理器（processors）封装算法特定的更新规则，迭代（iterations）管理分布式执行。平台支持异步操作、发布-订阅通信、托管式消息处理和独立算法的组合编排。

Result: 在原生Skywing运行时上对Push Sum、Max Consensus、组合式监控与控制工作流、延迟通信下的弹性Push Sum以及恶意数据损坏下的弹性异步Jacobi等算法进行了实验验证，表明Skywing能支持多样的去中心化算法。

Conclusion: Skywing将数学逻辑与通信及执行基础设施解耦，既可作为去中心化应用的部署框架，也可作为开发弹性数学算法的研究平台，适用于自主系统和信息物理系统等去中心化计算场景。

Abstract: Emerging edge, autonomous, and cyber-physical systems increasingly require mathematical computation across heterogeneous devices connected by unreliable communication networks. Traditional high-performance computing and distributed data-processing frameworks provide powerful abstractions for managed environments but are less suited to decentralized settings where centralized coordination, reliable communication, and global synchronization cannot be assumed. This paper presents Skywing, an open-source platform for decentralized mathematical computing in unreliable environments. Its programming model consists of three abstractions: agents represent participants in a decentralized computation, processors encapsulate algorithm-specific update rules, and iterations manage distributed execution. Skywing supports asynchronous operation, publish-subscribe communication, managed message handling, and the composition of independent algorithms into complex decentralized workflows. We demonstrate Skywing using representative algorithms from consensus, optimization, and numerical linear algebra. Experiments on the native Skywing runtime include Push Sum and Max Consensus, a composed monitoring and control workflow, resilient Push Sum under delayed communication, and resilient asynchronous Jacobi under malevolent data corruption. These demonstrations show that Skywing supports diverse decentralized algorithms while separating mathematical logic from communication and execution infrastructure. Skywing serves as both a deployment framework for decentralized applications and a research platform for developing resilient mathematical algorithms.

</details>


### [217] [BASP: Communication-Efficient Batch-Aware Sequence Parallelism for LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03151)
*Bigyan Ghimire,Jon C. Calhoun*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: BASP是一种批量感知的序列并行方法，通过根据微批量大小将GPU划分为不相交的序列并行组，减小all-to-all通信组规模，将通信局部化，在NVIDIA A100集群上将Llama和Qwen模型端到端训练时间提升1.17-1.31倍，且保持相同的模型精度和内存使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的长序列训练面临巨大的内存和通信开销。现有的序列并行方法不考虑批量大小（batch-agnostic），对所有批量大小应用统一的序列划分策略，导致通信效率低下。作者观察到这一点，提出利用批量结构来减少通信开销。

Method: BASP的核心思想是利用批量（batch）结构来优化序列并行：根据微批量大小将GPU划分为不相交的序列并行组（sequence-parallel groups），每个组负责处理各自的微批量数据。这种设计减少了all-to-all通信的组规模，实现了通信的局部化，从而提升训练效率。

Result: 在NVIDIA A100集群上的实验表明，相比标准的序列并行基线方法，BASP在Llama和Qwen模型中可将端到端训练时间提升1.17-1.31倍，同时保持完全相同的模型精度和内存使用量。

Conclusion: BASP通过批量感知的分组策略有效降低了长序列LLM训练中的通信开销，是一种在不牺牲模型精度和内存效率的前提下提升训练速度的有效序列并行方案。

Abstract: Long-context reasoning for large language models (LLMs) is becoming increasingly important, but training over long sequences remains challenging due to massive memory and communication requirements. Sequence parallelism has emerged as an essential technique for addressing bottlenecks in long sequence LLM training. However, we observe that existing sequence parallelism methods are batch-agnostic and apply uniform sequence partitioning across all batch sizes, resulting in inefficient communication. In this paper, we introduce Batch- Aware Sequence Parallelism (BASP), a sequence parallelism approach that leverages batch structure to reduce communication overhead. BASP exploits batch structure by partitioning GPUs into disjoint sequence-parallel groups according to the micro- batch size. This design reduces the all-to-all communication group size, thereby localizing communication and improving training efficiency. Experimental results on an NVIDIA A100 cluster show that BASP improves end-to-end training time by up to 1.17 - 1.31x in Llama and Qwen models compared to standard sequence parallel baselines, while preserving identical model accuracy and memory usage.

</details>


### [218] [Carbon-aware Resource Management for Latency-Sensitive Cloud Computing Environments: A Taxonomy and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03270)
*Tharindu B. Hewage,Shashikant Ilager,Maria Rodriguez Read,Rajkumar Buyya*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对云环境中延迟敏感型工作负载带来的碳足迹问题，对碳感知资源管理的最新文献进行了系统分类分析，构建了详细分类体系，分析现有工作的优化方面，识别研究空白，并指出未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着云基础设施持续扩展，延迟敏感型工作负载不断增加，导致碳足迹上升，与净零排放目标冲突。然而由于延迟优化通常采用性能导向的刚性部署模式，难以直接减少碳足迹，亟需利用应用特定机会的高效碳减排技术。

Method: 通过系统梳理碳感知资源管理在延迟敏感型云计算环境中的最新研究文献，构建详细的分类法（taxonomy），在此基础上对现有工作进行优化层面的分析、识别研究空白并提出未来方向。

Result: 形成了碳感知资源管理在延迟敏感型云计算环境中的详细分类体系，完成了对现有文献的优化分析，识别出当前研究的缺口。

Conclusion: 提出了碳感知资源管理领域未来有待深入探索的研究方向，为后续研究提供指引。

Abstract: Proliferation of cloud-based latency-sensitive workloads requires infrastructures tuned to their workload-specific latency constraints. Today, they shape the cloud from a generalized computing platform to diverse workload-specific cloud environments. As the demand for latency-sensitive workloads increases, cloud service providers continue to scale their infrastructure, adversely increasing the carbon footprint and challenging climate-crisis-driven net-zero emission goals. Due to performance-oriented rigid deployment patterns of latency-optimizations, reducing its carbon footprint is challenging. Therefore, efficient techniques that exploit application specific opportunities are needed in that. To this end, we present a detailed taxonomy of recent literature on carbon-aware resource management in latency-sensitive cloud computing environments. Using the taxonomy, we analyze existing works discussing their optimization aspects, identify the gaps, and highlight future research directions.

</details>


### [219] [FlowTT: Exploiting Computation Flow Reuse in Irregular Tensor-Train Embedding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03459)
*Jongmin Seok,Chae Eun Rhee*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了FlowTT，一种流感知的GPU执行框架，通过将TT嵌入查找重构为前缀共享的不规则计算流，结合流对齐的前缀索引分组、融合执行路径和持续线程调度，显著降低TT张量嵌入的延迟和峰值内存，在Meta合成推荐基准上相比现有方法推理延迟降低最多42.2%，训练延迟降低最多49.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TT分解虽然能有效压缩推荐模型中的大型嵌入表，但基于TT的嵌入查找仍然效率低下：跨输入索引的部分共享计算结果未被充分利用，且顺序TT核心收缩之间产生的中间结果被反复物化到片外，导致大量冗余计算和全局内存流量。

Method: FlowTT采用三层协同设计：(1) 流对齐的前缀索引分组，将TT gather重构为一组前缀共享的不规则计算流以最大化共享子计算的复用；(2) 融合TT嵌入执行路径，在片内保留中间结果避免片外物化；(3) 持久化线程调度，结合基于块的work stealing和L2 checkpointing来应对偏斜工作负载，实现任务形成、数据缓冲和调度的联合优化。

Result: 在Meta的合成推荐基准（Meta-240、Meta-480、Meta-788）上，FlowTT始终取得最低延迟。在batch size为32,768时，推理延迟相比EcoRec降低最多42.2%，训练延迟降低最多49.2%，同时实现了最低的推理峰值内存占用。

Conclusion: 暴露前缀共享的计算结构是高效TT嵌入执行的关键。通过将TT gather的执行流程与硬件特性（GPU调度、缓存层次）进行协同设计，可以有效减少冗余TT核心操作、全局内存流量和负载不均衡，从而在推理和训练场景中都取得显著的性能提升。

Abstract: Tensor-Train (TT) decomposition effectively compresses large embedding tables in recommendation models, but TT-based embedding lookup remains inefficient because partially shared computation flows across input indices are not fully reused and intermediate results are repeatedly materialized off-chip between sequential TT-core contractions.
